title: PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA)
description:
**Job Title: PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA)**
**Location:**
Gurgaon (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience:**
3–4 Years
  
  
**Notice Period:**
Immediate to 7 Days
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled
**PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA) with 3–4 years**
of hands-on experience in database administration, performance optimization, backup and recovery, replication, and production support. The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills and experience managing PostgreSQL databases in production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain PostgreSQL databases across development, staging, and production environments.
* Monitor database performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize SQL queries, indexes, and execution plans.
* Manage database backups, recovery, Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR), and disaster recovery processes.
* Configure and maintain PostgreSQL Streaming and Logical Replication.
* Perform database performance tuning, VACUUM, ANALYZE, and capacity planning.
* Handle production incidents, RTB (Run the Business), and BTB (Build the Business) activities.
* Implement database security, user roles, permissions, access controls, and auditing.
* Support database migrations, version upgrades, patching, and environment refresh activities.
* Automate routine database administration tasks using scripting and automation tools.
* Collaborate with application development, infrastructure, cloud, and DevOps teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of hands-on PostgreSQL database administration experience.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, query optimization, indexing, and execution plans.
* Experience with PostgreSQL backup, recovery, PITR, and replication.
* Understanding of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR).
* Strong experience in production database troubleshooting and performance monitoring.
* Good knowledge of Linux/Unix environments.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.
* Experience with Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools.

**Good To Have**

* Experience managing large-scale PostgreSQL databases.
* Exposure to MongoDB administration.
* Knowledge of Oracle or MySQL.
* Experience with database monitoring and observability tools.

**Joining Preference:**
Immediate joiners or candidates available within 7 days.
  
  
Skills: database performance tuning,communication skills,linux,sql,database backup and recovery,database replication,database administration,aws / azure / gcp,postgresql

title: Implementation Engineer
description:

title: Senior Specialist, Fusion Financials - FMS
description:
Save the Children International has an exciting opportunity for
**Senior Specialist, Fusion Financials - FMS**
to join our
**global team.**

**Team Purpose**

Purpose of the team is to lead on the development and configuration of Save the Children’s global business and operating applications used across SCI and Members. The team are key to maintaining the application portfolio as fit for purpose and developing new and existing systems in line with business requirements, maximising the value they deliver and enabling our organisation to achieve impact for children. Working in partnership with Transformation Delivery, the team are accountable for delivery of application developments for Transformation Delivery projects, SCI Functions and internal IT functions.

**Role purpose**

Working with members of the global TDIT team, the role holder will be responsible for building, implementing, continuously improving, supporting and analysing Finance Management System (FMS) solutions within the organisation. This role will partner with business stakeholders and product owners to understand their analytic requirements and implement and maintain finance solutions to meet these needs, utilising best practices.

The role holder will also be required to provide FMS specialist guidance, coaching or mentoring to other team members as required and supporting the FMS Product Development Manager in some team leading activities when required.

* **Job Title:**
  Senior Specialist, Fusion Financials- FMS
* **Reports To:**
  Senior Manager, Product Development (FMS)
* **Work Pattern:**
  Hybrid/Remote with flexible working options available
* **Location:**
  Any approved Save the Children International office location. For a full list of locations that Save the Children International can hire in, please visit: SCI Careers
* **Required Time Zone:**
  Any
* **Contract Length:**
  Permanent
* **Right to Work:**
  The successful candidate must have the right to work in the country where the role is based, for the duration of employment.
* **Language Requirements:**
  English
* **Remit:**
  Global

**Principal Accountabilities**

* Collaborate with the FMS transition project team to support the migration from Agresso to Oracle Fusion, including data validation, integrations, testing, and user support.
* Assist in the configuration, testing, and deployment of Oracle Fusion Financials modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, CM).
* Participate in post-go-live activities including system stabilisation, enhancement requests, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work as part of a Scrum team within an Agile product development environment, contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide support for day-to-day operations of Oracle Fusionwhere appropriate.
* Document processes, configurations, and training materials to support knowledge sharing and onboarding.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, data governance, and security standards.
* Assist in onboarding of new team members, and work with collaboratively with partners, key stakeholders and product owners to capture and prioritize new requirements.
* Support global users, manage development change requests, and ensure vendor engagement and SLA compliance.
* Collaborate with IT teams to maximize system performance, ensure platform updates, and participate in regression testing where needed.

**Experience and Skills**

***Essential***

1. Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials product
2. Proven experience in development, implementation and management of Oracle Fusion ERP (E-Business Suite or Fusion Cloud).
3. Functional knowledge of various Oracle Financial modules such as GL, AP, AR, EPM
4. Manage and validate quarterly Oracle Cloud updates and patches ensuring seamless deployment
5. Experience of solving complex business and technical issues through trouble shooting and analysis, defining a clear way forward and ensuring buy in from key stakeholders.
6. Good communication and interpersonal skills.

***Desirable***

* Team Leader role experience.
* Strong track record in administering and supporting applications in complex global organizations.
* Knowledge of major cloud services providers, like AWS, Azure etc.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience working in Scrum teams.
* Skilled in automated build and deployment processes.
* Knowledge of ITIL or similar service management frameworks.
* Non-profit sector knowledge/experience.

**Education and Qualifications**

***Essential***

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.

**Desirable**

* Oracle Certified Implementation Specialist – Fusion Financials (ERP).

**Working at Save the Children International**

Save the Children is the world's leading organisation for children, employing ~25,000 staff. We save children's lives. We fight for their rights. We help them fulfil their potential. Through our work in 116 countries, we put the most deprived and marginalised children first.

We know that great people make a great organisation, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive environment where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.

The work here is challenging but is also immensely rewarding. At Save the Children, you will be in good company, working with talented, like-minded individuals who are determined to ensure that all children survive, learn, and are protected. Your contribution will help ensure children's voices are heard at the highest levels, and that we achieve our global strategy,
**Ambition for Children 2030**
, and reach every last child.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Equal Opportunities**

DEI is core to our vision, values and global strategy. Save the Children is committed to creating a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive organisation, and one which will support us in our vision to ensure every child attains the right to survival, protection, development, and participation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, colour, ethnic origin, nationality, disability, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, pregnancy and maternity, caring or parental responsibilities, age, or beliefs and religion. We are committed to diversifying our staff to better represent the communities we serve and actively welcome underrepresented groups to apply.

Reasonable adjustments will be made should any candidate invited to interview require this.

**Application Information**

Please attach a copy of your CV and cover letter with your application. A full copy of the role profile can be found at SCI Careers. It is recommended that you save a copy of the role profile as it will no longer be available after the advert closes.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the job advert may be closed earlier than advertised subject to the volume of suitable applicants. Please submit your application at your earliest convenience to avoid disappointment.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Candidates who are successfully shortlisted should expect to hear from us within 2 weeks of the advert deadline.

**Our Recruitment Process**

1. Application review by our recruiting team based on your CV and cover letter
2. Two-stage competency-based interviews with the hiring team
3. Some recruitment may include an additional assessment or case study stage, or a third stage interview
4. If successful, you will receive a conditional offer of employment, followed by your contract subject to passing background checks

We need to keep children and adults safe so our selection process includes rigorous background checks and reflects our commitment to the protection of children and adults from abuse. All employees are expected to carry out their duties in accordance with our Code of Conduct and all policies and procedures relating to Anti-Harassment, Health and Safety, Safeguarding, and DEI and Equal Opportunities.

**Save the Children does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process.**

title: Senior Software Delivery Analyst - Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
  
  
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
  
  
When you join us, you will have:
  
  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will join our Client Capabilities Network in Gurugram or Bengaluru as part of the HALO (Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes) domain within the SHaPE (Social, Healthcare and Public Entities) practice.
  
  
You will contribute to building analytical products that help clients improve healthcare outcomes, leveraging modern data engineering tools and practices. Working as part of a team on active client engagements, you will support initiatives focused on delivering more affordable, accessible, and high-quality healthcare globally.
  
  
You will design and develop interactive dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, enabling clear and effective communication of insights to clients and internal stakeholders. You will also leverage emerging Generative AI tools and agent-based workflows to support delivery tasks such as code generation, data transformation, and documentation, improving productivity and solution quality.
  
  
In collaboration with data engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders, you will support the development and maintenance of data pipelines, software applications, and scalable data frameworks, including reusable assets that enable efficient data processing and analysis across projects. Your work also involves configuring and delivering data and software solutions aligned with client needs, while supporting client interactions where required.
  
  
You will translate client requirements into data models, configurations, and implementation steps under supervision, ensuring alignment with product capabilities. Applying structured problem-solving, you will help troubleshoot data and implementation challenges, while ensuring data quality and consistency in visualizations through validation of data sources and adherence to best practices in dashboard design. You will also contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and capability building across data engineering, visualization, and software tools.
  
  
SHaPE fosters innovation driven by advanced analytics, user experience design thinking, predictive forecasting to develop new products/services and integrating them into our client work. It is helping to shift our model towards asset-based consulting and is a foundation for our entrepreneurial culture.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
- 4+ years of experience building data-intensive applications using Python or similar languages, with strong proficiency in SQL (data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning)
- 2+ years of experience developing dashboards and working with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms
- Experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake) for data processing, storage, and analytics, along with exposure to distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Hive, Hadoop ecosystem)
- Exposure to Generative AI (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, AI-assisted development tools) and/or familiarity with NLP techniques and building data solutions leveraging unstructured data is a plus
- Solid understanding of software development best practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins), and Agile methodologies
- Interest in the healthcare domain preferred; prior experience not required
Willingness to travel as needed (expected travel- Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and client-facing environments

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Description**
Position at LeadVenture India
  
  
**Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Build Our Foundation**
**Location: Gurgaon, India (Hybrid)**
Are you an engineer who loves building the rock-solid foundation that everything else runs on? Do you enjoy the challenge of weaving different technologies—Windows, Linux, on-prem, and cloud—into a single, powerful platform?
  
  
If you want to architect and own the core infrastructure of a global company, this role is for you.
  
  
**Here is more of what you’ll get to do:**
Our company is growing incredibly fast and is a leader in multiple areas. Your mission is to help design, build, and manage the core infrastructure that powers it all.
  
  
This isn’t just about keeping the lights on. It’s about creating a scalable, secure, and efficient foundation for future growth.
  
  

* You will help architect and deploy the infrastructure for our new projects, ensuring they meet the highest standards for performance and uptime.
* You will master a hybrid world, expertly managing both Microsoft (Active Directory, IIS, SQL, Clustering) and Linux environments (Ubuntu, Apache, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch).
* You will own our resilience, implementing and managing complex backup, storage (SAN/NAS), and disaster recovery solutions.
* You will bridge the gap to the cloud, using your experience with public cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
* You will be the expert, acting as an escalation point for critical issues and mentoring junior engineers.

**You’ll thrive in this role if you have:**

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a mixed mode (onsite, remote or hybrid) environment, including consistent use of video conferencing, collaboration tools, and proactive communication practices while maintaining a professional on-camera presence.

**Virtualization and SAN storage**

* Strong hands-on experience with one of Hyper-V, VMware/ESXi, or Nutanix, with working knowledge of a second.
* Experience with VM provisioning, host maintenance, high availability, and troubleshooting.
* Basic experience working remotely with SAN storage, preferably Pure Storage or HPE Nimble.

**Windows, Linux, and application infrastructure**

* Experience supporting Windows Server and Linux, preferably Ubuntu, with stronger expertise in one.
* Comfortable with patching, upgrades, permissions, services, and performance troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of IIS and NGINX/Apache, plus a basic understanding of HAProxy, reverse proxying, backend health checks, and load balancing.
* Exposure to Windows Failover Clustering and SQL Server Always On Availability Groups is preferred.

**Active Directory and related services**

* Good understanding of domains, domain controllers, DNS, Group Policy, authentication, and replication, with practical experience troubleshooting domain joins and login issues.
* Familiarity with Windows/Linux domain integration.

**Exposure to public cloud**

* Foundational experience supporting AWS (preferred) or Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, access controls, and monitoring.

**Configuration management and scripting**

* Working experience with Puppet or Ansible, including maintaining existing configurations and troubleshooting failures.
* Ability to understand, maintain, and adapt scripts using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

**Operational ownership and collaboration**

* Structured troubleshooting, proactive stakeholder updates, timely ticket records, clear documentation, and willingness to share knowledge and support junior engineers.
* Ability to collaborate across global teams and participate in on-call support and planned maintenance.

**AI-assisted operations**

* Practical use of Claude, ChatGPT, or similar approved tools for troubleshooting, analysis, scripting, and documentation.
* Able to refine prompts, validate recommendations, and protect sensitive information while improving efficiency and accelerating delivery.

**Nice-to-have skills**
**Monitoring and centralized logging**

* Experience using Zabbix and the ELK stack for monitoring, alert investigation, log analysis, and infrastructure troubleshooting.

**Backup, disaster recovery, and SOC 2**

* Experience with enterprise backups, preferably Veeam, including failure investigation and restores.
* Understanding of RPO/RTO, business continuity, recovery testing, and SOC 2 controls and evidence.

**Networking, firewalls, and load balancing**

* Broader experience with TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, NAT, firewall rules, and load-balancer configuration.
* Ability to investigate connectivity issues and coordinate changes with networking/security teams.

**CI/CD**

* Exposure to Jenkins, Octopus Deploy, or similar tools, including pipelines and deployment troubleshooting.

**Kubernetes**

* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and Rancher, including workloads, services, ingress, and troubleshooting.

**Infrastructure as Code**

* Familiarity with Terraform or similar tools, including version-controlled configurations, state management, and drift detection.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
  
  
This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
* Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. title: Senior Analyst - MIS
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Job Type: Permanent
  
  
Application Deadline: 01 November 2026
  
  
**Job Description**
**Title**
Senior Analyst - MIS
  
  
**Department**
General Counsel Shared Services
  
  
**Location**
India
  
  
**Reports To**
Manager, GC Systems Functional Admin
  
  
**Level**
Grade 3
  
  
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our General Counsel Shared Services team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**About Your Team**
General Counsel (GC) is a trusted advisor to all parts of Fidelity International Limited (“FIL”), providing high-value independent advisory and assurance expertise through our specialist teams. GC comprises of Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, and Public Policy & Strategic Relationship Management. GC Shared Services function (GCSS) is a global centre of expertise currently in Dalian and India, providing operational support and services to the General Counsel function. GCSS Functional administration team (FA team) provides first line business support & manage the functional administration activities for various GC owned systems.
  
  
**About Your Role**
Join the GCSS Functional Admin team and play a key role in the functional administration of GC-owned technology platforms. This dynamic techno-functional position combines technical expertise with business and functional knowledge to deliver first-line support for both AI-enabled and non-AI cloud-based systems owned by the GC function.
  
  
Responsibilities include providing day-to-day support to users for system-related queries and issues, performing initial triage, resolving issues where possible, and escalating more complex issues as needed. The role also involves conducting requirements and data analysis, monitoring system adoption and licence utilisation, and supporting user acceptance testing (UAT) and release readiness activities.Beyond day-to-day system administration, you will contribute to the change management lifecycle by partnering with business product owners to analyse the requirements, assess data impacts, and support the delivery of new features and enhancements. Acting as a business analyst, you will help shape improvements across GC-owned technology platforms, including StarCompliance, IRM ServiceNow, and other strategic systems.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Provide first-line operational support to business users of GC-owned technology platforms, responding to system-related queries, issues, and requests.
* Collaborate closely with technology and vendor support teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve business-as-usual (BAU) issues.
* Support the delivery of system changes and enhancements initiated by business and technology teams.
* Partner with external vendors to implement system enhancements, configuration changes, and process improvements.
* Participate in requirements gathering, business analysis, user acceptance testing (UAT), and release readiness activities throughout the change lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain documentation, including standard operating procedures, process guides, system data flows, and training materials, while delivering end-user training as required.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across business, technology, and vendor teams.
* Analyse and interpret complex datasets using Excel and other analytical tools to support decision-making, system optimisation, and operational reporting.
* Apply working knowledge of Risk and Compliance processes to support the effective administration and enhancement of GC-owned technology platforms.

**Skillsets Required**
About 4+ years of experience working as support analyst or business analysis or data analyst, or in change management, collaborating closely with both business and technology teams, having the following skillsets:
  
  

* High level technical understanding of large IT systems including Cloud, SAS or on-prem systems.
* Experience or knowledge in General Counsel functions, Risk/Compliance, Star Compliance, IRM ServiceNow platform is preferred but not mandatory.
* Team player with excellent stakeholder management capabilities, while being proactive and adpatable.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess complex situations, identify risks and develop practical solutions effective at a global level.

**Feel rewarded**
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team.
  
  
For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Technical Solution Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
The candidate joins Cloud Domain Support team, focusing on Ericsson products like Cloud Execution Environment (CEE) and Cloud Container Distribution (ECCD). The team fosters continuous learning and knowledge sharing to deliver high customer satisfaction. This hire will resolve customer service requests (CSRs), troubleshoot complex virtualized infrastructure and container issues, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and maintain high network availability.
  
  
**What you will do:**
To investigate, troubleshoot, deliver remedy & restorations, and produce solutions to customer support tickets, CSRs (Customer Service Requests).
  
  
To work within well-defined system support guidelines.
  
  
To participate in software upgrades and updates.
  
  
Should be able to use support tools for ticket handling.

Actively engage in communication with other engineers for the purpose of knowledge sharing etc.

In the line of supporting our products, identify possible improvements that make them more maintainable and user-friendly. Document these as Requirement Specifications as input to the design of new generations of the products.
  
  
Registration of new known solutions and updating of existing known solutions based on answers/solutions developed within own line organization or received from elsewhere.
  
  
Providing suggestions in developing Operation & Maintenance instructions.
  
  
Isolate product faults and raise them to Product Design. Support design unit to reproduce the fault and evaluate the final fix provided.
  
  
May need to work in shifts and Emergency Support rota.
  
  
To lead and execute the implementation of new software releases on test labs.
  
  
Writing documents for fault analysis/RCA along with required preventive and corrective actions.
  
  
Strong analytical skills.
  
  
24×7 availability as per support guidelines.
  
  
**The skills you bring :**
Relevant experience of 2-8 years .
  
  
Deep knowledge of Linux (SUSE/SLES, Red Hat/RHEL or Ubuntu) including extensive hands-on administration and troubleshooting (systemd, journald, networking, storage, performance).
  
  
Virtualization technologies (KVM/QEMU, libvirt).
  
  
Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash/Shell).
  
  
OpenStack knowledge and hands-on experience, OpenStack distribution (core services: Keystone, Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Heat).
  
  
Understanding of NFV/NFVI architecture and ETSI MANO concepts; VNF/CNF onboarding and VIM integration (e.g. with orchestrators such as EVNFM).
  
  
High-availability clustering (Pacemaker/Corosync), load balancing and virtual IP management (HAProxy, keepalived/VRRP).
  
  
Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting (control plane, kubelet, scheduling, RBAC, workloads) with hands-on operational experience.
  
  
Container runtimes (containerd, Docker) and image/registry handling.
  
  
Cluster lifecycle management on bare metal using Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3, and cluster lifecycle tooling (e.g. ccdadm).
  
  
etcd operation, backup/restore and recovery fundamentals.
  
  
Kubernetes networking (Calico/CNI, Multus, kube-proxy) and policy enforcement (e.g. Kyverno).
  
  
Solid IP networking fundamentals (L2/L3, routing, VLANs, static routes, MTU, TLS/PKI troubleshooting).
  
  
Virtual machine and container internetworking concepts.
  
  
Open vSwitch (OVS) and OVS-DPDK.
  
  
SR-IOV functionality and DPDK-based high-performance networking.
  
  
Host network configuration tooling (NetworkManager/nmstate).
  
  
CEE: software-defined and cloud storage – OpenStack Cinder, Ceph, Nexenta, Dell Powerflex.
  
  
ECCD: Ceph and NetApp (CNIS deployments); ScaleIO/PowerFlex and Nexenta (NFVI-based deployments).
  
  
General block/object/file storage concepts.
  
  
Configuration management and automation (Ansible).
  
  
Orchestration templating (Heat/TOSCA).
  
  
Monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana; log aggregation such as Fluentd/Fluent Bit).

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

title: Dynamics 365 Technical Consultant
description:
Dynamics 365 Technical Consultant

About StarZen

StarZen is the Global Capability Center (GCC), based in Gurugram, India.

From India, StarZen delivers technology, IT and customer-operations capabilities for the group. It works alongside global partners such as Microsoft, Apple, Samsung and Huawei. Joining StarZen means building enterprise systems that run a regional telecom and retail business, with the pace and ownership of a growing team.

Role at a glance

Job title : Dynamics 365 Technical Consultant

Department: Enterprise Technology

Reports to: Head of IT

Location: Gurugram, India

Experience: 5+ years in Microsoft Dynamics 365 technical development

Employment type: Full-time, permanent

About the role

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 Technical Consultant to own the technical side of our D365 platform. You will design, build and integrate solutions that support Finance, Procurement and Operations across the business.

This is a hands-on senior role with leadership scope. You will write code, shape the architecture and lead a small team. You will also manage the D365 development budget and advise leadership on where the platform should go next.

Key responsibilities

**Solution design and architecture**

* Contribute to the technical design and architecture of Dynamics 365 solutions.
* Turn functional requirements into detailed technical specifications and scalable designs.
* Analyse complex business processes and produce technical design documents.

**Development and customisation**

* Customise and extend D365 using X++, C#/.NET and JavaScript.
* Build extensions and configurations with a focus on user experience and a holistic product approach.

**Integrations**

* Build and maintain integrations with third-party systems using REST APIs, OData, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus or middleware.
* Develop and manage custom web services and APIs.

**Support, documentation and improvement**

* Diagnose and fix issues in D365 environments, custom code and integrations.
* Work closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders.
* Maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, specifications and integration mappings.
* Keep up with Microsoft release updates and best practices.

**Budget and ROI**

* Plan and manage the D365 development and integration budget.
* Track spend and return on investment, and find cost savings without lowering quality.

**Team leadership**

* Lead, mentor and develop a team of D365 professionals.
* Set and track KPIs, and support the team's training and growth.
* Build a collaborative, innovative way of working.

**Collaboration and platform insights**

* Partner with Finance, Procurement, Operations and other teams to align ERP plans.
* Analyse system performance, usage and integration errors to find optimisation and automation opportunities.
* Advise on platform enhancements, technical debt and new D365, Power Platform and Azure capabilities.

**What we're looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* Microsoft certifications
  **MB-300**
  (Core Finance and Operations) and
  **MB-500**
  (Finance and Operations Apps Developer).
* 5+ years of hands-on Dynamics 365 technical development, preferably in Finance & Operations (F&O).
* Strong X++, C#/.NET and JavaScript skills for customising and extending D365.
* Proven integration experience with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions and Service Bus, plus REST APIs and OData.
* Experience with SSRS reporting and D365 data management tools (DMF, data entities).
* At least one end-to-end D365 implementation, through to go-live.

**Nice to have**

* Experience leading or mentoring a development team.
* Exposure to Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) and Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, LCS and CI/CD for D365.
* Experience in telecom, retail or Middle East projects.

**How we work**

We look for people who:

* **Shape strategy**
  : make sense of complex data and trends, and use them to guide decisions.
* **Drive change**
  : adapt quickly and bring others along to new ways of working.
* **Lead teams**
  : take ownership and build momentum toward shared goals.
* **Deliver results**
  : hold high standards for performance and quality.
* **Build customer value**
  : understand what users need and communicate clearly.
* **Influence collaboratively**
  : build strong relationships across teams and levels.

All roles follow our Quality, Occupational Health & Safety and Information Security management systems.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About us\***
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.
  
  
Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
  
  
Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Stress Testing & Forecasting Analytics team sits within the CFO Organization and is aligned to support Global Markets Business. Stress Testing & Forecasting Analytics team is responsible for executing the quarterly baseline and stress forecasts across various businesses within Global Markets. The team is also responsible for developing expertise and enhancing the forecasting models.
  
  
The team needs to engage with senior stakeholders across the firm to conduct review and challenge meetings on quarterly basis with respect to the forecast results. The data and infrastructure needed for the forecast process is also owned by the team. There is high regulatory involvement given the key role the team performs in the CCAR process, Recovery and Resolution Planning, Stress loss forecasting etc.
  
  
**Job Description\***
We are seeking a technically strong individual to support the Global Markets (GM) Stress Testing Platform within Global Business Services (GBS). The role is responsible for supporting the QFAP/R forecasting platform, which underpins critical regulatory and internal forecasting processes including CCAR, ICAAP, Recovery & Resolution Planning (RRP), and quarterly stress testing exercises.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a key role in the implementation, maintenance, production support, automation, and enhancement of Global Markets forecasting models and infrastructure. The position requires strong technical expertise in R programming, platform support, data management, analytics, and software development practices, along with an understanding of stress testing and forecasting processes within a Global Markets environment.
  
  
The role will partner closely with Forecast Analysts, Model Developers, and US-based stakeholders to ensure the reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement of the forecasting platform. The individual will also help drive modernization initiatives leveraging emerging technologies including GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted development, workflow automation, and analytics tooling.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Support the day-to-day management of the Global Markets QFAP/R forecasting platform.

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Technical Account Manager – Oracle Database**
Technical Account Manager (TAM), combining strong Oracle Database expertise with customer relationship management, strategic account planning, and service delivery leadership. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping enterprise customers improve database availability, performance, security, and operational efficiency across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  
  
You will translate customer business priorities into actionable technical plans, coordinate Oracle teams, and oversee service commitments. The role requires technical judgment, clear communication, and ownership of customer outcomes—from proactive risk management and technology adoption to critical incident coordination and continuous improvement
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Customer relationship management: Build trusted relationships with database administrators, architects, IT leaders, and executive stakeholders. Understand their business objectives, technical environments, and operational priorities.
* Strategic account planning: Develop and maintain technical account plans, service roadmaps, and customer success plans with clear milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes.
* Service delivery and governance: Coordinate contracted service deliverables, track commitments and applicable service levels, and conduct regular operational reviews and executive business reviews.
* Incident and escalation management: Lead customer communication during critical incidents, coordinate support and engineering teams, track resolution activities, and drive follow-through on root cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Proactive database health management: Coordinate health checks, performance reviews, capacity assessments, and availability evaluations to identify risks and recommend improvements.
* Database lifecycle planning: Guide customers through database upgrades, migrations, patching, platform modernization, and cloud adoption, including readiness assessments and risk mitigation.
* Availability and recovery: Review high availability architectures, backup strategies, disaster recovery readiness, and recovery testing against customer recovery objectives.
* Security and governance: Advise on database security practices, access controls, encryption, auditing, and vulnerability remediation in collaboration with customer security teams.
* Technology adoption: Help customers evaluate relevant Oracle Database, OCI, automation, and AI capabilities based on business value and operational readiness.
* Customer advocacy: Represent customer priorities within Oracle, coordinate cross-functional resources, and communicate product feedback and recurring issues.
* Continuous improvement: Maintain account documentation, action registers, service dashboards, and technical recommendations that demonstrate progress and service value.

**Required Database And Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Oracle Database administration, architecture, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management, including Oracle Database 19c and familiarity with Oracle AI Database 26ai.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Multitenant architecture, including container databases, pluggable databases, provisioning, consolidation, and resource management.
* Experience with Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Automatic Storage Management (ASM), Oracle Data Guard, and Active Data Guard.
* Strong database performance analysis and SQL tuning skills, including execution plans, indexing, optimizer statistics, wait events, AWR, ASH, and ADDM.
* Experience with RMAN backup and recovery, restore validation, disaster recovery planning, and recovery time and recovery point objectives.
* Knowledge of Oracle Exadata architecture, workload optimization, and operational considerations.
* Experience planning database migrations, upgrades, and patching using appropriate tools such as Data Pump, AutoUpgrade, GoldenGate, and Zero Downtime Migration.
* Familiarity with OCI database services, Oracle Autonomous AI Database, Exadata Database Service, and Exadata Cloud@Customer.
* Understanding of database security capabilities, including Transparent Data Encryption, privilege management, auditing, Oracle Data Safe, and Database Vault.
* Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL, Linux/Unix fundamentals, and scripting or automation using Python, shell scripts, Ansible, or Terraform.

**Modern Database Skills — Preferred**

* Familiarity with Oracle AI Vector Search, vector embeddings, similarity search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) use cases.
* Awareness of Select AI and natural language access to enterprise data.
* Understanding of JSON Relational Duality, modern SQL capabilities, and support for relational, JSON, spatial, and graph workloads.
* Knowledge of cloud database observability, infrastructure automation, and performance and cost optimization.
* Ability to assess the operational, security, and governance requirements of AI-enabled database solutions.

**Technical Account Management Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical issues through their business impact and recommended actions.
* Experience managing escalations, setting expectations, resolving conflicts, and maintaining customer confidence.
* Strong planning, prioritization, and coordination skills across multiple accounts or concurrent initiatives.
* Understanding of incident, problem, and change management practices, preferably aligned with ITIL.
* Ability to define and track service measures such as customer satisfaction, milestone completion, recurring incident reduction, and risk remediation.
* Demonstrated ownership, analytical thinking, and effective collaboration across distributed teams.

**Qualifications**
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant experience in Oracle Database technologies and customer-facing technical account management, consulting, enterprise support, or service delivery is required. Oracle Database, OCI, and ITIL certifications are desirable.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Global M&C Data Architect Director & Chapter Lead – MarTech
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The MarTech Data Architect & Data Engineering Chapter Lead for Marketing & Communications is a senior technical leader responsible for the engineering excellence, architectural integrity, and continuous evolution of BCG's marketing data foundation and connected platforms. Sitting within the MarTech Engineering team, this person leads the data engineering chapter that serves BCG's Global Marketing analytics and data functions owning the technical standards, pipeline architecture, and data platform capability that underpins the full marketing analytics and data ecosystem, from CRM data operations and audience segmentation through to Tableau dashboard delivery, channel performance intelligence, and AI-assisted insight generation.
  
  
A core part of this ownership is the identity resolution model the framework that matches and unifies client and contact records across marketing data and CRM systems into a single trusted profile. The Chapter Lead designs, manages, and continually refines this model, and partners closely with BCG's core data architect, client, marketing, CRM and engineering teams and data functions to maintain a shared, consistent definition of identity across systems.
  
  
This role also carries direct responsibility for aligning the marketing data layer with BCG's wider enterprise data approach. The Chapter Lead partners with enterprise data governance and architecture teams to ensure marketing's data standards, access controls, lineage, and quality practices are built to firm-wide policy rather than developed in isolation representing marketing's needs in enterprise governance forums while bringing enterprise requirements back into the marketing data roadmap.
  
  
The role sits at the intersection of technical leadership and marketing analytics product delivery. The Chapter Lead is not only the most senior data engineering voice they are an active partner to the product owners, analysts, and insight leaders whose work depends on the reliability, quality, and sophistication of the data infrastructure this person builds and leads. They lead and develop the data engineering team, set the data engineering direction in line witht the overall MarTech strategy and standards, establish the data standards, and ensure that BCG's marketing data platforms are capable of supporting not just today's analytics needs but the agentic intelligent data environment the marketing organization is building toward.
  
  
Chapter Leadership & Data Engineering Development
  
  

* Lead the data engineering chapter serving BCG's Global Marketing & Communications team setting technical direction, establishing engineering standards, and creating an environment where engineers across squads are developing their skills, doing their best work, and growing their careers
* Provide architectural oversight and hands-on review of engineering work across the chapter code quality, architectural consistency, pipeline reliability, and data modeling standards are upheld across all squads the chapter serves
* Actively mentor and develop chapter engineers conducting regular technical reviews, providing structured feedback, identifying growth opportunities, and building the collective engineering capability that allows the chapter to take on increasingly sophisticated data and AI challenges over time
* Partner with squad product owners to ensure engineering capacity, technical priorities, and sprint commitments are aligned with the analytical products and insight capabilities the marketing organization depends on
* Contribute to hiring decisions, team structure, and data engineering development helping build a chapter that is technically excellent, well-motivated, and capable of sustaining the marketing analytics function's growing ambitions

Data Pipeline Architecture & Engineering
  
  

* Design, document, and implement robust, scalable data pipelines that feed the marketing analytics data models powering BCG's dashboard suite, channel insight products, audience intelligence, and CRM data operations built on Snowflake, dbt, and Apache Airflow as the core platform stack
* Build monitoring and alerting for match-rate quality, pipeline failures, and unexpected shifts in merge/split volume Establish a lineage trail so any resolved identity can be traced back to its contributing source records and the logic that merged them
* Build processes to handle un-merging (splitting incorrectly merged records) as well as merging
* Implement data standardization logic (name normalization, address formatting, email canonicalization) as a pre-processing layer ahead of matching
* Integrate data from across BCG's marketing technology ecosystem into the marketing data environment in a structured, governed, and scalable way that supports both current reporting needs and future analytical capability
* Apply SCD, CDC, and DQ/DV frameworks rigorously across pipeline development ensuring that data arriving in the marketing master dataset is accurate, complete, historically traceable, and fit for the analytical and insight purposes it is intended to serve
* Evaluate and implement new technical solutions, data engineering patterns, and platform capabilities that improve the reliability, performance, and sophistication of BCG's marketing data infrastructure contributing MVPs and proofs of concept that demonstrate feasibility before committing to full implementation

Data Quality, Governance & Security
  
  

* Own the data quality and governance standards for BCG's marketing data engineering environment implementing the monitoring, validation, and alerting frameworks that catch data quality issues before they surface as errors in stakeholder-facing dashboards or analytical outputs
* Implement data performance and data security policies that align with BCG's governance objectives, regulatory requirements, and privacy obligations working in close partnership with enterprise data governance, IT security, and legal colleagues to ensure the marketing data environment meets the firm's standards across all dimensions
* Maintain clear, accessible documentation of data models, pipeline architecture, transformation logic, and engineering decisions building institutional knowledge that reduces key-person dependency and supports the chapter's resilience as it grows

AI & Identity Resolution Architecture
  
  

* Design the end-to-end identity resolution architecture spanning CRM, marketing automation, web/behavioral data, campaign platforms, and third-party data sources
* Define the matching strategy: deterministic rules (exact matches on email, phone, CRM ID) vs. probabilistic matching (fuzzy name/address matching, behavioral signals), and when each applies
* Design the "golden record" / unified profile structure what fields it contains, how conflicting values are resolved, and which source system wins for each data type
* Build a confidence-scoring framework so matches are tiered (auto-merge, flag-for-review, reject) rather than treated as all-or-nothing
* Define the survivorship rules most recent, most complete, most trusted source that determine what data persists into the unified profile when records merge
* Design for scale and extensibility so new data sources (new martech tools, new regions, new business lines) can be onboarded without re-architecting the core model

Technical Monitoring & Incident Management
  
  

* Actively monitor the health, performance, and reliability of BCG's marketing data pipelines and Snowflake environment — establishing the observability frameworks, alerting standards, and incident response protocols that minimize disruption to the analytical products and insight outputs the marketing organization depends on
* Lead the triage and resolution of critical technical incidents with urgency, clarity, and sound engineering judgment — communicating clearly with product owners and stakeholders throughout, and ensuring that root cause analysis and remediation are completed systematically rather than reactively
* Identify and address performance bottlenecks across the data engineering environment — conducting regular performance reviews and implementing optimization improvements that keep the platform scalable and responsive as data volumes, analytical complexity, and user demand grow

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Build strong working relationships with external stakeholders across BCG's global data and technology organization ensuring that marketing's data engineering work is aligned with firm-wide data standards and that dependencies are managed proactively
* Partner with IT architecture and platform teams on shared infrastructure decisions — including AWS cloud services, Azure Active Directory integration, and CI/CD pipeline tooling — ensuring marketing's engineering choices are compatible with BCG's broader technology environment
* Engage with product portfolio management and cross-functional data product teams across finance, HR, legal, and other BCG functions — contributing a marketing analytics perspective to firm-wide data platform conversations and maintaining awareness of cross-functional data and security trends that affect the marketing data environment

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Leading a chapter of data engineers with technical authority and genuine investment in their development — you set a high bar, model it yourself, and bring people along rather than simply holding them to it
* Designing data pipeline architectures and Snowflake data models that are not just technically correct but genuinely built for the analytical consumption patterns of a sophisticated marketing analytics function — you think about the downstream insight need as much as the upstream engineering requirement
* Writing advanced SQL and well-structured dbt models that your colleagues can read, understand, maintain, and build on — you treat code quality and documentation as professional obligations, not optional extras
* Navigating the intersection of data engineering and marketing analytics with enough domain fluency to engage credibly with product owners, analysts, and insight leaders — you understand what they are trying to build and why, and you engineer solutions that serve those needs rather than just satisfying technical requirements
* Bringing a current and practical perspective on AI and its implications for data engineering — you are not evangelizing AI for its own sake, but you have a well-formed view of where intelligent automation, Snowflake Cortex, and LLM integration create genuine engineering opportunity in a marketing analytics context
* Staying calm and effective in critical incidents — you triage with sound judgment, communicate clearly under pressure, and resolve issues systematically rather than reactively
* Collaborating with product owners and Agile teams in a way that adds engineering value to product decisions — you show up to sprint ceremonies prepared, you flag technical risk early, and you help the squad make better product decisions by making the engineering trade-offs visible and understandable

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 13+ years of data engineering experience with a strong focus on data warehouse architecture, pipeline development, and data modeling, including at least 2–3 years in a chapter lead, technical lead, or senior engineering leadership role
* Demonstrably advanced SQL proficiency and deep hands-on experience with Snowflake — including data modeling, performance optimization, security configuration, and consumption layer design for analytical workloads
* Expert-level proficiency with dbt for data transformation and data model development, and strong hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for pipeline orchestration and job scheduling
* Solid experience applying SCD, CDC, and DQ/DV frameworks in production data engineering environments — you have built these patterns, maintained them, and debugged them when they break
* Demonstrated ability to write clean, well-documented, version-controlled code — you use GitHub or Bitbucket as a professional standard, not an afterthought
* Experience integrating data from complex, multi-platform marketing or enterprise technology ecosystems — familiarity with platforms such as Dynamics CRM, Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, or equivalent marketing technology is a meaningful advantage
* Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts as they apply to data engineering — including intelligent pipeline orchestration, AI-assisted data quality, and the evolving role of Snowflake Cortex or equivalent capabilities in analytics environments
* Strong Python scripting skills for pipeline development, automation, and data engineering tooling; experience with PowerShell or equivalent a plus
* Experience with cloud platforms — AWS preferred, Azure and GCP also valued — and familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tooling and version control workflows in a production data engineering environment
* Experience working in Agile and scrum-based delivery environments — including active participation in sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and cross-functional squad collaboration with product owners, architects, and data SMEs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — including the ability to present architecture decisions, engineering trade-offs, and technical recommendations to non-technical product owners and marketing stakeholders clearly and confidently
* Experience with JIRA and Confluence for delivery management and technical documentation
* Familiarity with other data platforms including Oracle, SQL Server, or MDM systems is a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Who You'll Work With
  
  
This role operates within BCG's Global Marketing analytics and data hub functions as the senior technical leader of the data engineering chapter that serves it. Your most important day-to-day working relationships are with the engineers in your chapter — the people whose technical growth, work quality, and professional development you are directly accountable for — and with the product owners across the marketing analytics and data hub squads whose roadmaps depend on the reliability and capability of the engineering infrastructure your chapter builds and maintains.
  
  
Within the analytics function, you will partner closely with the Director of Marketing Analytics and the Director of Data Hub who run the squads who access, monitor, and deliver insights and data driven insights for the global marketing organization. You will also collaborate with the CRM data operations and CRM engineering leads — ensuring that the data quality and governance standards that apply at the platform level are reflected in the CRM data environment that feeds the broader marketing analytics ecosystem.
  
  
Beyond the marketing analytics and data hub functions, you will be expected to engage regularly with BCG's enterprise data organization to ensure marketing's engineering work is aligned with firm-wide data standards and that shared infrastructure decisions reflect marketing's needs. You will also work with IT architecture, cloud platform, and security colleagues on the infrastructure and governance dimensions of the marketing data environment.
  
  
At the most senior level, you will engage with the Director of Marketing Analytics & Data and Director of Data Hub as a peer and strategic partner — contributing the engineering perspective that shapes how the function's data platform capability evolves, how AI and emerging technology are incorporated into the chapter's roadmap, and how BCG's marketing analytics and data infrastructure is positioned to support the organization's most ambitious data and insight ambitions.
  
  
This is a role for a data engineering leader who finds genuine satisfaction in the combination of deep technical craft and organizational impact — who wants to build something that is not just technically excellent but genuinely indispensable to how a world-class marketing organization understands and acts on its data.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Senior Solution Implementation Specialist
description:
Software Implementation (SWI) Engineer

India

Software Implementation (SWI)

Willingness and ability to travel internationally, including to the United States
**Experience:**
3–8 years preferred About the SWI Team The
**Software Implementation (SWI) team**
is responsible for ensuring the successful implementation, integration, testing, and deployment of GreyOrange software and automation solutions at customer sites. SWI engineers work at the intersection of
**software, testing, automation, and customer implementation**
. The role involves working closely with GreyOrange products, simulations and emulations, customer systems, and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure solutions are thoroughly validated and successfully transitioned into production. This is a highly technical, hands-on role for engineers who enjoy
**troubleshooting complex software issues, testing APIs and integrations, writing automation scripts, and working directly with customers**
. Key Responsibilities Software Testing & Validation
  
  

* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing of GreyOrange products and solutions.
* Execute simulation and emulation testing to validate system behavior before and during customer implementations.
* Develop and execute detailed test scenarios, test cases, and validation plans.
* Identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and document software defects and integration issues.
* Perform log analysis and root-cause investigation of complex technical issues.
* Validate system performance, reliability, and interoperability across multiple software and hardware components.

Customer Implementation & Deployment

+ SIT (System Integration Testing)
+ UAT (User Acceptance Testing)
+ HAT (Hardware Acceptance Testing)
+ Go-Live
