title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
JD:
**Senior Platform Architect (Tech Lead)**

**Location:**
Noida

**Reports to:**
CTO

**Type:**
Full-time, individual contributor tech lead

**About Sutra.AI**

Sutra.AI is a complete ‘Data to Value’ AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose-built for mid-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.

**The role**

You own how the platform is built. You are the hands-on technical lead for the core platform and the data layer that every product runs on. You set the architecture, write and review the critical code, and hold the bar on quality, security and scale. You take over day-to-day platform and data architecture from the CTO.

Engineers across the platform look to you for technical direction, design review and code review.

Stack you should be familiar with

* **Data:**
  open lakehouse (Trino, Apache Iceberg), change data capture, data quality monitoring
* **Ingestion:**
  AI-assisted connectors for ERP, SQL databases, files and SaaS sources
* **AI:**
  leading LLMs on AWS and GCP, agents and tool-calling (MCP), vector search
* **Apps and services:**
  Python, FastAPI, Next.js, MongoDB, Postgres
* **Observability:**
  OpenTelemetry-based tracing, LLM tracing and evals, product analytics
* **Cloud:**
  AWS and GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Compliance:**
  SOC 2, HIPAA-ready deployments

**What you will own**

* **Core platform architecture:**
  security, scalability, multi-tenancy, connector standards, extension points.
* **Data access and performance:**
  a governed data access layer that serves interactive apps with fast response times alongside heavy AI agent workloads, with cost and latency under control.
* **Interfaces between teams:**
  clear, written contracts between platform components so product teams build on the platform, not around it.
* **Code quality:**
  review standards, design reviews, hands-on review of critical paths. Raise the bar for the whole team.
* **Security and compliance by design:**
  least privilege, fine-grained data access controls that AI cannot bypass, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit trails. Turn compliance requirements into architecture, not paperwork.
* **Reliability:**
  SLOs, observability, on-call design, self-healing pipelines, and scaling as customer usage grows.
* **Technical direction**
  for data engineers and full stack engineers.

**Must have**

* 8+ years building backend and data platforms, with recent hands-on coding. You still ship.
* Built production data pipelines and platform infrastructure: lakehouse or distributed query engines (Trino, Spark, Iceberg, Delta or similar), CDC and ingestion, data quality.
* Strong distributed systems and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
* Security-first: IAM, least privilege, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit. Experience in a SOC 2, HIPAA or similarly regulated environment.
* Hands-on AI exposure: shipped LLM or agent features in production, and understand evals, tool-calling and MCP well enough to design platforms for them.
* Has made architecture decisions at scale and lived with the consequences.
* Leads through design and code review. People want your review.

**Nice to have**

* Query engine internals, catalog performance, query planning
* OpenTelemetry and LLM observability tooling
* Kubernetes and Terraform across AWS and GCP
* Enterprise system integration (ERP and other line-of-business systems)
* Healthcare, defense or financial compliance programs

**This role is not**

A people manager. A pure DevOps or SRE role.

**How we hire**

* Intro with the CTO
* Architecture deep dive: walk us through a platform you designed, including what you would change
* Live design: a governed data access layer for a multi-tenant AI platform
* Code review exercise
* Final with CEO

**What you get**

Ownership of the platform every product runs on, direct work with the CTO, real enterprise data problems, and meaningful equity.

title: NetSuite Administrator
description:
**About The Position**
**About Coralogix**
Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data at scale. Our unique in-stream analytics architecture eliminates reliance on expensive indexing and hot storage, delivering APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, AI Observability, and more — helping customers reduce observability costs by up to 70% while gaining deeper operational insight.
  
  
We are a high-growth, 100M+ ARR business, and the systems that power our revenue engine need to match that pace. The companies winning right now are not the ones with the biggest sales teams — they are the ones with the smartest revenue systems. This team builds those systems.
  
  
**The Role**
Let's be direct about what this role is and is not. This is not a ticket-queue administration role where you grant access, run reports someone else designed, and escalate anything hard to a consultant. NetSuite is the system of record for revenue at Coralogix — every order, every invoice, every subscription, and every recognised dollar lives there. You will own it.
  
  
Today, most NetSuite work at Coralogix is done by third-party contractors. That is precisely the problem this role solves. We want this expertise in-house, sitting inside the GTM Engineering team, close enough to the business to anticipate what Finance and Sales need rather than wait to be told — the same way we own Salesforce expertise in-house today.
  
  
A significant near-term priority is our CPQ go-live and the quote-to-cash chain that runs through it. You will own the NetSuite side end to end: the sales order model, amendments and change orders, billing schedules, invoicing, and the handoff into revenue recognition. You will also own replacing our current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — designing and building it, not supervising someone who does.
  
  
**What You Will Build**
**Platform Ownership — Every Week**

* Own the NetSuite instance end to end — custom records, fields, forms, transaction types, roles, permissions, and the subsidiary and segmentation structure behind them
* Write production SuiteScript 2.x — User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelets, and RESTlets — not as an exception, as the default
* Build and maintain SuiteFlow workflows and approval routing for orders, quotes, journal entries, and vendor records
* Design saved searches, datasets, and SuiteAnalytics workbooks that Finance and GTM leadership actually use to run the business
* Own sandbox refreshes, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) projects, bundle management, and the twice-yearly NetSuite release cycle — including regression testing ahead of every upgrade

**Quote-to-Cash & CPQ Go-Live**

* Own the NetSuite side of our CPQ implementation — item and pricing model, sales order creation, and the full downstream billing and revenue chain
* Build and maintain amendment and change-order flows: upsells, downgrades, co-terming, renewals, and mid-term pricing changes — the part that breaks first and is hardest to unwind
* Configure SuiteBilling subscriptions, billing schedules, and invoicing logic to match how we actually sell, not how a textbook assumes we do
* Partner with Finance on Advanced Revenue Management — revenue arrangements, revenue elements, and recognition rules — so recognised revenue reconciles cleanly to what was sold
* Support multi-subsidiary and multi-currency structures as we open new entities and enter new markets

**Integrations & Automation**

* Replace the current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — you design it, you build it, you own it
* Build and maintain SuiteTalk REST/SOAP and RESTlet integrations across the GTM and finance stack
* Instrument every integration with real error handling, retry logic, and alerting — a silent sync failure discovered at month-end is a failure of the system, not of the person who found it
* Automate the recurring manual work that consumes Finance's month-end and quarter-end close
* Feed NetSuite revenue data into our Snowflake data foundation in partnership with the Data Engineer, so ARR, churn, expansion, and contraction reporting runs off governed data

**Governance, Data Integrity & Support**

* Own data integrity across NetSuite — customers, items, orders, invoices, subscriptions — and treat a discrepancy as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* Design and maintain role and permission structures with segregation of duties in mind, and support audit and control requirements as the company matures
* Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks so the platform is never a single point of failure
* Act as the escalation point for NetSuite issues across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success — and fix the pattern, not just the ticket

**Requirements**

* 5–9+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience, including recent time as the primary administrator or technical owner of a production instance
* Production SuiteScript 2.x experience — you write it and you debug it; you are not describing work a partner did on your behalf
* Deep working knowledge of SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics (saved searches, datasets, workbooks), and NetSuite's role and permission model
* Demonstrated understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash and record-to-report process — from order capture through billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition. This is the business process your system models; fluency with it is non-negotiable.
* Experience working directly with Finance teams — AR, revenue accounting, controllership — translating accounting requirements into system design rather than waiting for a written specification.
* Hands-on Workato experience — Workato is our current integration platform across Salesforce, NetSuite and the finance stack, and you will own both the flows running on it today and their migration
* Hands-on experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce and other SaaS platforms via SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and middleware (Celigo, Boomi, or similar)
* Experience with SuiteBilling or an equivalent subscription billing model, and with CPQ-to-ERP order flows
* Working exposure to Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) or equivalent revenue recognition tooling
* OneWorld / multi-subsidiary and multi-currency experience
* Experience with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), source control, and structured deployment practices rather than changes made directly in production
* SaaS or subscription-business experience strongly preferred — recurring revenue behaves differently from one-time sales, and it shows
* Exposure to commissions tooling (CaptivateIQ or similar) and the order-to-commission data flow is a plus, not a requirement
* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteCloud Developer, ERP Consultant) preferred — a strong recent hands-on track record will outweigh certifications in our evaluation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

**The Non-Negotiables**

* You are hands-on in NetSuite today — configuring, scripting, and debugging in your primary role, not directing others who do it
* You can point to systems and integrations you built yourself, and explain both the decisions you made and the ones you got wrong
* You understand quote-to-cash end-to-end — you can explain how an order becomes an invoice, how a mid-term amendment changes a billing schedule, and how both land in recognised revenue. You have built systems that model this journey and you don't need it rephrased.
* You default to automation when you encounter a task you have done more than twice
* You treat a data discrepancy or a silent integration failure as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* You can hold a direct conversation with a controller and with a software engineer in the same hour, and be useful to both
* Systems thinking — you reason about how a change in NetSuite propagates to Salesforce, the CPQ, billing, commissions, and the data warehouse
* AI fluency — you use AI tools daily in your work and actively evaluate new ones

**Cultural Fit**
We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Application Administrator
description:
As an Application Administrator your primary responsibly is to manage, optimize and maintain enterprise (business) application software for the AVI-SPL organization. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for all software operations, ensuring that applications align with business processes while supporting organizational growth initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams – including Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and HR to design workflows, manage user access, build custom reports, and troubleshoot technical issues to ensure maximum system efficiency. In addition, you will partner with other members of the IT organization including business analysts, software engineers, and other platform managers to ensure optimal utilization of our applications.
  
  
**Who We Are**
AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.
  
  
Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. Our success starts with our people; and a workplace that champions culture and belonging ensures we grow and thrive together.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As an Application Administrator your primary responsibly is to manage, optimize and maintain enterprise (business) application software for the AVI-SPL organization. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for all software operations, ensuring that applications align with business processes while supporting organizational growth initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams – including Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and HR to design workflows, manage user access, build custom reports, and troubleshoot technical issues to ensure maximum system efficiency. In addition, you will partner with other members of the IT organization including business analysts, software engineers, and other platform managers to ensure optimal utilization of our applications.
  
  
**Day-To-Day Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders across multiple geographies (including India and Canada) to document and analyze business requirements for NetSuite.
* Design, develop, and maintain custom scripts (SuiteScript 1.0/2.0), workflows, and integrations within NetSuite.
* Perform testing, debugging, configuration (as needed) and documentation activities during development and planned in-place upgrades.
* Provide technical expertise and support to end-users and stakeholders, assisting with troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Conduct system maintenance, including upgrades, patches, and enhancements in accordance with best practices and business needs.
* Design, build, and test automated business workflows using built-in workflow tools.
* Maintain documentation of system configurations and customizations.
* Maintain and update core system configurations, forms, fields, custom records, and general ledger settings.
* Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks and implement optimizations as needed
* Troubleshoot system errors, resolve user helpdesk tickets, and coordinate with the software platform provider for platform bugs.
* Keep up to date with latest application features, functionalities, and industry trends

+ User Management: Provision user accounts, manage custom roles, assign permissions, and conduct regular security access audits.
+ Data Integrity: Monitor data imports, perform regular data cleansing, and manage data migration tasks.
+ Reporting & Analytics: Create, modify, and maintain complex Saved Searches, KPIs, dashboards, and financial reports.
+ Release Management: Test business processes during platform upgrades and manage the sandbox environment.
+ Training & Documentation: Develop internal training materials and provide hands-on guidance to onboarding users.

* Perform additional tasks, responsibilities, and projects as needed to support the team and organization, ensuring flexibility in adapting to evolving priorities and objectives.

**Must-Haves**
**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* 5-7+ years of experience in NetSuite development and administration with minimum 3-5 years of professional hands-on experience with NetSuite platform administration including configurations, integrations, data model, report development, and in-place upgrades.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of professional experience with IT applications.
* Certified as a NetSuite Foundational Specialist.
* Strong proficiency in SuiteScript (JavaScript), SuiteFlow, and SuiteAnalytics.
* Experience with NetSuite ERP modules (Finance, Inventory, CRM).
* Solid understanding of integration technologies (REST, SOAP, APIs).
* Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Clear and professional communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
* Ability to build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across all levels of the organization leveraging direct, clear and confident communication.
* Ability to work with and manage stakeholders across the globe.
* Stable presence with strong judgment and decision-making quality.
* Ability to work and think independently; self-starter that demonstrates initiative and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously; demonstrates effective prioritization skills when balancing dynamic priorities.
* Inquisitive and data-oriented.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Proven time management skills with attention to detail.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint), requirements management tools (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps), visualization and diagramming tools.
* Two-year degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field is required.

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Certified as a NetSuite Administrator Professional.
* Certified as a NetSuite BI and Saved Searches Professional.
* Four-year degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), or related field is preferred.
* ITIL Certification

title: Data Operations Associate
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience understanding complex data structures, schemas, and migration requirements, combined with proficiency in extract, transform, and load processes across enterprise environments.
* 3-7 years’ experience required for this role. Proficiency in SQL for data querying, manipulation, and validation, with experience mapping data fields between source and target systems to meet business rules and technical requirements.
* Knowledge of data validation techniques, data quality assurance best practices, and data governance principles, including documentation of business rules, standard operating procedures, and data lineage.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP or NetSuite, and hands-on experience with reporting and automation tools including Power Automate, Power BI, Alteryx, or Databricks; experience with master data management tools such as Collibra or DBeaver preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong problem-solving ability; capable of collaborating across business users, data stewards, and technical teams while clearly explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's / postgraduation degree in finance or Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field required

**Responsibilities**

* Supports enterprise-wide data migration initiatives by ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data as it transitions across systems.
* Analyzes data structures and identifies migration requirements, collecting, cleaning, and validating datasets from multiple source systems
* Documents business rules for data quality checks and applies validation and quality assurance techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency throughout the migration lifecycle
* Maps data fields from source to target systems and transforms data to align with new system requirements and business rules
* Executes data migration processes including extraction, transformation, and loading, monitoring migration progress and troubleshooting issues in real time
* Identifies and resolves data discrepancies, errors, and anomalies, collaborating with technical teams to implement corrective actions
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and visualizations to highlight key trends and document data quality issues for stakeholder review
* Works closely with business users, data stewards, and technical teams to gather requirements, communicate progress, and facilitate cross-functional alignment to ensure a smooth migration transition
* Creates and maintains comprehensive documentation including migration plans, data mappings, validation rules, standard operating procedures, and post-migration reports to support governance and audit readiness

**About The Team**
Our Ratings Operations and Controls (ROC) team is responsible for supporting the data management, quality, and operational processes that underpin Moody's global ratings and research activities. We contribute to Moody's by ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and consistency across critical systems, enabling seamless data transitions that support business continuity and analytical integrity, and driving operational efficiency through technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in enterprise data migration, digital transformation, and process innovation across our Gurgaon operations.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
  
  
For more information on the Securities Trading Program, please refer to the Securities Trading Policy on Moody’s Compliance Expo page
  
  
Please note: STP categories are assigned by the hiring teams and are subject to change over the course of an employee’s tenure with Moody’s.

title: Reliability Engineer II
description:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.
  
  
Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.
  
  
Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.
  
  
At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best
  
  
At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Supporting and maintaining Tower’s next-generation Post Trade systems, including monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on the status, performance, and overall health of production environments
* Collaborating with trade support teams, developers, and end users across multiple regions to understand business requirements, provide technical expertise, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure timely resolution
* Diagnosing and troubleshooting bugs and technical issues across existing production platforms, while documenting production incidents, interventions, and corrective actions taken
* Leading and contributing to system migrations and the automation of support activities to improve operational efficiency, reliability, and scalability
* Designing and implementing enhancements to support systems that improve reliability and enable self-correction, while supporting the integration of new execution venues, trading products, and data vendors
* Defining and implementing certification criteria for system enhancements and new products before production release, ensuring their integration into testing and deployment processes

**Qualifications**

* At least 2–6 years of experience working in a fast-paced, global team environment, including diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues
* Experience supporting enterprise applications using Java, Python, Linux shell scripting, and job schedulers, with strong proficiency in Java and Python required
* Experience working with SQL databases, including MySQL and PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB and Elasticsearch
* A background in electronic trading, with a thorough understanding of financial instruments, including equities, commodities, credit, interest rates, foreign exchange, cryptocurrencies, futures, forwards, and options, is a plus
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams

**Benefits**
Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.
  
  
At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* Generous paid time off policies
* Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
* Hybrid working opportunities
* Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
* In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
* Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
* Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
* Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
* Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.
  
  
Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment
description:
**Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment**

**About Urban Company**

Urban Company is Asia's largest tech-enabled home services marketplace, operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Customers use our platform to book a wide range of services — beauty and grooming, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and more — delivered at home, at a time of their choosing. Behind this simple promise sits a deep technology stack that matches millions of customers with trained, background-verified service partners while guaranteeing a standardised, high-quality, and reliable experience every single time.

**About the Fulfilment Team**

The Fulfilment team sits at the heart of Urban Company's marketplace — we make sure every customer gets the right service, from the right partner, at the right time. We do this through three core charters:

- Planning & Shaping: Efficiently planning supply to meet forecasted customer demand, and intelligently shaping that demand to meet business goals.

- Capacity Management: Managing partner time and computing real-time availability of UC services for any given time slot, customer location, business category, and skill requirement.

- Allocation & Recovery: Assigning the most suitable partner for each job while maintaining fairness in partner earnings, and protecting customer experience in cases of no-shows, cancellations, or partner unavailability.

These are classic marketplace optimization problems — forecasting, matching, scheduling, and real-time recovery — solved at the scale of millions of monthly service requests.

**Job Description: SDE-2**

We are looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE-2) to join our Fulfilment team. You will work on complex, high-impact engineering challenges — the systems you build directly determine whether a customer's booking is fulfilled seamlessly and whether a partner earns fairly. If you enjoy problems that blend distributed systems, optimization, and real-world operational constraints, this is the team for you.

**Responsibilities**

- Design and build scalable, high-performance, fault-tolerant systems and services that power supply planning, capacity, and allocation.

- Develop and optimize intelligent algorithms and ML/AI-driven solutions for demand forecasting, capacity planning, and partner–job matching.

- Own features end-to-end — from ideation and design to deployment, monitoring, and iteration across a modern tech stack.

- Raise the bar on the team's engineering practices: code quality, system architecture, observability, and operational excellence.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into robust technical solutions.

**What Are We Looking For?**

- Experience: 2–3 years of experience building large-scale backend applications or Products.

-Technical Strength: Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Networks, and Database fundamentals, with a good understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, caching, and scalable architectures.

- Backend Skills: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Node.js, Java, Go, or Python). Experience with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and messaging systems like Kafka is a plus; exposure to cloud platforms and production observability is desirable.

- AI Fluency: Hands-on experience leveraging AI in day-to-day engineering — using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to ship faster, and/or building with LLMs, ML models, or intelligent automation in production systems. Curiosity to apply.

- AI to real marketplace problems is a strong plus.

- Mindset: Bias for action, end-to-end ownership, and comfort with ambiguity.

- Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.

**Why Join Us?**

- Work on marketplace-scale optimisation problems that few companies in the region get to solve.

- High ownership from day one — your systems ship to millions of users.

- A culture that rewards initiative, craftsmanship, and first-principles thinking.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.
  
  
The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
* System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
* Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
* System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
* Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
* Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
* Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
* Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
* Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
* AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
* Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
* Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
* Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
* Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
* Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
* Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
* Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
* Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
  
  
This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
* Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: RCM Admin
description:
**Position Summary:**

The RCM Administrator serves as the central administrator and subject matter expert for the OneStream Account Reconciliation Management (RCM) platform. This role is responsible for maintaining global account reconciliation master data, supporting monthly close and reconciliation processes, administering user access and security, ensuring policy compliance, and providing operational support to regional and business unit finance teams.

The RCM Administrator acts as the primary point of contact for RCM-related activities, partnering with Corporate Accounting, Finance Systems, Internal Controls, Segment Controllers, and regional Super Users to ensure the integrity, accuracy, and effectiveness of the global account reconciliation process.

**Key Responsibilities**

**RCM System Administration**

* Administer and maintain the OneStream RCM application and supporting processes.
* Execute monthly Discover and Process activities to identify new reconciliation inventory and account changes.
* Maintain company-wide RCM settings, reconciliation attributes, workflows, due dates, and risk profiles.
* Create, update, and maintain account groups, ownership assignments, and reconciliation hierarchies.
* Manage mass updates and configuration changes within the RCM environment.
* Coordinate implementation of approved governance and change-control decisions.

**Monthly Close and Reconciliation Support**

* Create and communicate monthly RCM task plans and deadlines.
* Monitor reconciliation progress and completion status throughout the close cycle.
* Maintain monthly folders, reporting files, and supporting documentation.
* Perform integrity reviews of reconciliation inventories, account groups, frequencies, due dates, and risk assignments.
* Identify and resolve reconciliation ownership gaps, including assignment of newly created accounts.
* Support global finance teams throughout the month-end reconciliation process.

**Master Data Management**

* Maintain reconciliation ownership structures, including preparers, approvers, locations, business units, and regional assignments.
* Review and process requests for organizational changes, personnel changes, and account realignments.
* Ensure consistency and compliance of reconciliation group structures.
* Support implementation of acquisitions, reorganizations, business transfers, and entity changes affecting reconciliation ownership.

**User Support and Security Administration**

* Serve as first-level escalation point for RCM administration and system support.
* Coordinate OneStream access requests, user onboarding, reactivations, and security changes.
* Assist users and Super Users with troubleshooting, training, and process questions.
* Provide guidance regarding security groups, reconciliation assignments, workflows, and reporting.

**Governance, Compliance, and Controls**

* Ensure reconciliation processes comply with company policy and internal control requirements.
* Perform monthly validation of group integrity, risk classifications, frequencies, and due dates.
* Support internal and external audit requests related to reconciliation administration.
* Participate in governance reviews and change-control discussions impacting RCM operations.
* Maintain documentation supporting compliance and control effectiveness.

**Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain reconciliation trackers and management reporting files.
* Support Power BI reporting and reconciliation analytics.
* Analyze recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Partner with Finance Systems teams to improve automation and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate and facilitate recurring RCM management meetings as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of accounting, finance operations, controllership, shared services, or financial systems experience.
* Experience with account reconciliations and month-end close processes.
* Experience administering financial systems, ERP applications, or reconciliation platforms.
* Strong understanding of internal controls and financial governance processes.
* Advanced Excel skills and ability to manage large volumes of financial data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* OneStream Account Reconciliation Management (RCM) experience.
* Experience supporting global finance organizations.
* Knowledge of financial master data management and workflow administration.
* Experience with Power BI, reporting tools, or finance system integrations.
* Project management and change management experience.

**Critical Success Factors**

* Strong attention to detail and data integrity.
* Excellent organizational and workload management skills including email management.
* Ability to influence and partner across multiple business units and regions.
* Strong customer-service mindset and responsiveness.
* Ability to manage sensitive financial data and maintain appropriate controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical/critical thinking skills

description:

**About The Role**
We are looking for a Staff Integration Engineer (Workato & API Integration) to join our GTMTech team. This strategic role will lead the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise-grade integrations that power our core business processes across GTM systems, with a primary focus on Workato-based integrations and modern API management patterns.
  
  
You will own the architecture for critical integration domains such as Quote-to-Cash and other high-impact GTMTech programs, ensuring our integration landscape is scalable, secure, observable, and aligned with best practices for event-driven and API-first designs. You will partner with engineering, architecture, security, and business stakeholders to define standards, mentor other integration engineers, and drive continuous improvement in how we connect systems and data.
  
  
The GTMTech team is focused on high-impact, large-scale technology programs, such as Quote-to-Cash. Our mission is to enhance company efficiency, boost profitability, and enable data-driven decision-making by streamlining systems, optimizing processes, and minimizing manual, low-value work through automation and AI.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of Workato-based integrations and APIs across GTM systems (e.g., Salesforce, NetSuite, HRIS, Google Workspace) with a focus on scalability, reliability, and security
* Define and evolve integration standards, patterns, and best practices, including canonical integration patterns, error-handling strategies, observability, and operational runbooks
* Design and review complex, event-driven integration workflows leveraging technologies such as Kafka or equivalent messaging platforms, ensuring robust handling of topics, producers/consumers, durability, and retry mechanisms
* Drive API-first and MCP-native design for GTM integrations, leveraging RESTful APIs alongside MCP-based interfaces and AI-driven services, including robust authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT), versioning, lifecycle management, and integration with API management platforms such as Apigee or similar
* Translate ambiguous, cross-functional business requirements into well-structured technical designs, evaluating multiple solution approaches and recommending the best fit for scalability, extensibility, and long-term maintainability.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other integration engineers—coaching on Workato concepts (callable recipes, event streams, task optimization), API design, and integration patterns, and performing design and code reviews
* Partner closely with GTM, Finance, Data, and Security teams to align integration designs with data governance, compliance, and audit requirements, including CI/CD practices and environment strategies for Workato and associated services
* Establish and enforce non-functional requirements (NFRs) for integrations (performance, resiliency, observability, security), and ensure they are met through design, testing, and monitoring
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues spanning multiple systems and environments by performing deep root-cause analysis and driving long-term corrective actions in partnership with system owners
* Conduct POCs to validate technology or pattern choices (e.g., new Workato features, API capabilities, event streaming approaches) and guide the team on when and how to adopt them
* Participate in and help mature the on-call and support rotation for integrations, ensuring robust incident response, escalation, and communication practices
* Champion and role model MongoDB’s culture principles—Think Big, Make it Happen, Build Together, and Be Intellectually Honest—while driving high standards for technical excellence and operational rigor within GTMTech.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 10+ years of enterprise integration experience, including significant time in lead/architect roles
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience designing and delivering complex, enterprise-grade integration solutions using Workato, with deep understanding of the platform beyond low-code/no-code capabilities (e.g., advanced recipes, callable recipes, event streams, Workato SDK, task optimization, governance)
* Strong experience operating Workato in production at scale, including environment strategy, deployment automation, observability and monitoring, logging, and robust debugging in multi-system landscapes
* Solid understanding of event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Kafka or equivalents, including topics, producers/consumers, message durability, failure handling, and retry strategies
* Proficient with Workato connectors (including but not limited to Salesforce, NetSuite, HRIS, and Google Workspace), coupled with strong scripting skills (e.g., Python or Ruby) for advanced transformations and custom logic when required
* Demonstrated experience defining and enforcing integration standards, patterns, and NFRs across teams, including performance, scalability, security, and operability benchmarks
* Excellent analysis and system design capabilities, with a focus on system interactions, data flows, scalability, performance, and mapping complex business requirements into elegant, maintainable technical solutions
* Strong troubleshooting skills across diverse technologies and environments, with the ability to quickly isolate issues and drive cross-functional teams toward resolution
* Ability to mentor and upskill teammates, lead design and architecture reviews, and influence stakeholders through clear communication and well-reasoned recommendations
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and hybrid environment, and open to occasional travel as needed for key workshops or stakeholder engagements.

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 months, you will have:
  
  

* Gained a deep understanding of the GTMTech integration landscape, including key Workato recipes, APIs, and event streams across Quote-to-Cash and adjacent domains
* Ownership of at least one critical integration domain, stabilizing existing integrations and addressing high-priority issues or technical debt.

In 6 months, you will have:
  
  

* Designed and delivered high-quality, scalable integration solutions (recipes/flows and APIs) for key GTMTech initiatives, with measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and observability
* Established or refined integration standards and NFR guidelines (including SLAs/SLOs, error-handling patterns, and monitoring dashboards) and gained adoption across the GTMTech integration team
* Led design reviews and architecture discussions for new integration initiatives, ensuring alignment with event-driven and API-first strategies and influencing technology choices where appropriate.

title: Director - T&O Data Engineering
description:
**About This Role**
The BlackRock Data Office (BDO) advances the firm's enterprise data strategy by building trusted, scalable, and governed data products that power investment, business, operational, and technology outcomes across BlackRock. As a member of the Data Office organization, you will partner closely with product managers, data stewards, platform engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and senior business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data capabilities that enable analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital products. The team is at the forefront of shaping BlackRock's next generation data ecosystem and driving data as a strategic asset across the firm.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As a Director, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale data platforms architect who wants to do more than produce designs or provide technical advice, and drive the delivery of high-impact data solutions that support critical business and investment outcomes. You will define architectural direction for complex engineering initiatives, establish best practices across teams, serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders across technology and the business, and measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, and developer productivity.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape long-term data strategy, mentor engineering talent, and accelerate the firm's adoption of modern data and AI-enabled capabilities
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve the target-state architecture for enterprise-scale data platforms, shared services, application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs), metadata, configuration, and data models, while guiding investments and technology adoption that improve scalability, reliability, performance, security, interoperability, and developer experience.
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams from technical discovery and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and adoption, validating architectural decisions against production outcomes and adjusting designs as needed.
* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader BlackRock Data Office strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise data technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps with planned delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Extensive experience in data platform architecture, data engineering, distributed systems, or related disciplines, including designing scalable, reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective enterprise data platforms across complex, multi-team environments.
* Experience designing governed data platforms for AI and structure, semi-structure and unstructured-data workloads, including object storage, document management, metadata, retrieval, vector or graph technologies, security, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in Python, Java, Scala, SQL, Snowflake, DBT, cloud-based data platforms, and large-scale distributed data analytics environments, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade solutions.
* Strong experience designing and operating high-volume batch and real-time data pipelines, workflow orchestration solutions, data-transformation frameworks, and distributed event streaming architectures.
* Expertise in cloud and hybrid technology environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, data governance, metadata management, lineage, and enterprise security controls.
* Strong understanding of application programming interfaces, data modeling, data-quality frameworks, observability, performance optimization, and modern software-engineering practices supporting scalable platforms.
* Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and influencing organizational standards in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
* Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and enterprise data patterns that enable AI-ready products and platforms.
* Proven architecture leadership and technical judgment across workflow orchestration, Data Operations, release management, observability, cloud infrastructure, and source-control and delivery platforms, with the ability to simplify systems and make pragmatic trade-offs.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
  
  
With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.
  
  
Link to our fundraising announcement
  
  
**Key Offerings Of Hunch**

* One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.

**About The Role**
We're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.

**Preferred Experience**

**What We Offer**

* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).

**Life at Hunch**
Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.
  
  
**What We Hire For - The ABCs**
Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
  
  

* Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.

**How We Work**

* Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.

**Backed by Global Investors**
Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
  
  
**Experienced Leadership**
Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

description:

data-driven decision-making. Our engineering teams build scalable web applications, APIs, and cloud-based services that

development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade software solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess comprehensive technical expertise across the entire software development lifecycle,

with the ability to independently architect, build, deploy, manage, and optimize complete software ecosystems. The role

requires a strong combination of software engineering, cloud computing, infrastructure management, system

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

The candidate must have proven experience working with Internet of Things (IoT) applications and platforms, along with

extensive hands-on expertise in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

The selected professional will take end-to-end technical ownership of projects, resolve complex engineering challenges,

guide development teams, and ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Take complete technical ownership of software projects, covering requirement analysis, technical planning,

solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Independently architect, design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications, mobile

applications, APIs, and cloud-based services.

• Design intuitive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces while ensuring consistent user experience, performance,

and accessibility.

• Develop robust frontend and backend applications, reusable components, scalable services, and secure integration

mechanisms.

• Architect, deploy, configure, secure, and manage production environments on both AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Design and maintain databases, data processing pipelines, distributed systems, caching mechanisms, and highvolume data handling solutions.

• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, infrastructure automation, and application

release processes.

• Ensure system availability, performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and disaster recovery across

production environments.

• Design and implement secure, scalable IoT applications, including device connectivity, telemetry processing, realtime monitoring, and third-party platform integrations.

• Establish software engineering standards, conduct code reviews, implement automated testing, and ensure

application and infrastructure security.

• Independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving application performance, databases,

networking, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and production environments.

• Evaluate technology choices, define solution architectures, prepare technical documentation, and recommend

appropriate implementation approaches.

• Lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, coordinate development activities, and collaborate with

management and stakeholders to deliver business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

• Extensive hands-on proficiency in programming languages and modern application development technologies,

including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SQL.

• Strong practical experience with modern frameworks and technologies such as Angular, React, Next.js, Django,

FastAPI, Node.js, or equivalent platforms.

• Experience designing and developing web and mobile applications along with a strong understanding of UI/UX

principles and design tools.

• Expert-level knowledge of both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including cloud networking, compute, storage, identity

management, security, managed databases, serverless computing, container orchestration, monitoring, and

infrastructure architecture.

• Advanced experience with Linux server administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, with

experience in database design, query optimization, replication, and data processing.

• Extensive understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message

brokers, asynchronous processing, and third-party integrations.

• Proven experience designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure software solutions, including load

balancing, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.

• Strong experience with production monitoring, centralized logging, observability, incident management, and

troubleshooting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor.

• Hands-on knowledge of software testing methodologies, automated testing frameworks, API testing, performance

testing, application security, and secure coding practices.

• Mandatory experience with IoT applications and platforms, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, IoT

cloud services, and communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, UDP, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, etc.

• Strong analytical ability, architectural decision-making, technical documentation, problem-solving, and leadership

skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**
