Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, including hands-on development, solution architecture,

cloud infrastructure, and technical leadership.

• Proven experience leading complex software projects and independently managing technical responsibilities

throughout the complete software development lifecycle.

• Demonstrated expertise in designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads on both

AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Prior professional experience working on IoT-based products, platforms, or enterprise IoT integration solutions is

mandatory.

• Proven ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain complete enterprise software solutions.

• Strong technical leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Skills

specializations.

• Experience developing IoT solutions for smart metering, utilities, smart infrastructure, industrial systems, or device

management.

• Familiarity with LoRaWAN Network Servers (LNS), IoT gateways, communication protocols, and integration with

external IoT platforms.

• Experience working with multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud environments, large-scale distributed systems, and

enterprise security architectures.

• Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI-powered applications, and intelligent automation.

• Experience mentoring engineering teams, managing multiple technical initiatives, and providing technical guidance

across the software delivery lifecycle

As a member of the Data and Platform Governance team, this individual will implement and maintain data governance strategies, including enforcement of policies, guidelines, standards, and procedures.
  
  
The position supports Product - Material Master Data Governance within the SAP S/4HANA environment, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and compliance across the organization. Responsibilities include driving data quality initiatives, developing metrics and reports to monitor data integrity, performing root cause analysis of data issues, and contributing to system design improvements.
  
  
The role will also collaborate with SAP technical teams by supporting ABAP code analysis, BADI enhancements, integrations between the MDM platform and S/4 Hana, troubleshooting MDG-related logic and workflows impacting customer and vendor master data.

* A key responsibility is configuring SimpleMDG modules for vendor and customer master (Product - Material), establishing business rules, approval workflows, and validation logic.

* Support the implementation of data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms
* Support the integration of master data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms with target systems like S/4 Hana, Salesforce, and the Enterprise Data Platform among others.

* Assist with regular compliance reviews against policies and standards.
* Identify downstream impacts of master data change.
* Ensure proper monitoring of all integrations between the MDM Platform and other systems.

* Support the implementation and enhancement of BADIs and other extension frameworks used in MDG validation, derivation, and workflow logic.

* Perform technical analysis of SAP tables, CDS views, and data models to support data governance reporting and validation.

* Assist with impact analysis during system changes, upgrades, or SAP S/4HANA transformations affecting Customer master data structures

CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.

* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business

title: NetSuite Suite Projects Pro System Administrator
description:
Location: New Delhi, India
  
  
Reporting to: Kate Fisher, Senior IT Associate
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About CPI**
CPI is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change.
  
  
With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. We are unique in our focus on finance, our ability to get the right people to the table, and our analytical rigor.
  
  
**About The Role**
The NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro System Administrator will be responsible for maintaining and managing CPI’s NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro environment, ensuring that project and resource data remain accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with organizational standards. This role will provide day-to-day system support, manage user access and configuration, and work closely with Operations, Finance, and IT teams to ensure smooth system adoption across the organization.
  
  
The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, enjoys working with data and systems, and has a strong service mindset to support staff queries and drive efficient system usage.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage and maintain the NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro (Formerly Net Suite OpenAir) system, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
* Configure, test, and update system settings, workflows, and permissions as required.
* Provide first-line user support, resolving issues and queries in collaboration with the Operations and IT teams.
* Monitor and maintain project, resource, and timesheet data, ensuring consistency across departments.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics to support operational decision-making.
* Coordinate with the vendor (Xero/Oracle NetSuite/OpenAir) for upgrades, enhancements, and troubleshooting.
* Managing large data imports and updates manually and via integration manager.
* Manage a SuiteProjects pro system where financial data is not held in NetSuite and integrates with CPI’s
* Conduct user training and onboarding sessions, ensuring consistent use of the platform.
* Create and maintain management processes in the system including data checking and validation.
* Create and maintain system documentation, SOPs, and data dictionaries.
* Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency and user experience.

About You: Competencies and Experience
  
  

* Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science/IT systems Management and/or Business Administration, Engineering, and/or relevant certifications or professional experience.
* Overall, 6 years of relevant experience in system administration or operations roles with ERP, PSA, or project management tools such as NetSuite Suite Projects Pro, NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle.
* Demonstrated experience in data management, reporting, and workflow configuration.
* Strong Excel skills particularly for data transformation, cleaning and validation, including formulas, text formulas, XLookup and pivot tables.
* Experience working in small set up and managing projects independently with limited supervision.
* Experience working in multi-country or global organizations preferred.
* Experience creating documentation, and training users in IT Systems and processes.
* Familiarity with reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) is a plus.

About You: Personal Attributes
  
  

* Confidence to engage with a wide range of stakeholders and explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
* Excellent organizational skills and a proactive, organized, and innovative approach to problem solving.
* Customer-service orientation with the ability to manage queries efficiently.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within timelines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Position Details
  
  
CPI is recruiting for one full-time position of NetSuite Suite Projects Pro System Administrator (40 hours) to be based in our New Delhi office.
  
  
CPI India has adopted a flexible working policy whereby staff are able to mix working remotely with days in the office.
  
  
CPI offers an excellent and competitive compensation and benefits package.
  
  
Applicants must be eligible to work in India – we are unfortunately unable to offer any visa sponsorship for this role.
  
  
To Apply
  
  
As part of your application please upload your resume and cover letter, both documents must be submitted in English and respond to the application questions by Monday, November 2, 2026.
  
  
We do not recommend the use of AI to complete your application.
  
  
Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis, so we encourage applicants to submit at the earliest opportunity.
  
  
Only short-listed applicants will be contacted.
  
  
Please be sure to add notifications@app.bamboohr.com to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us.
  
  
CPI Commitment
  
  
CPI’s mission is to create economic opportunity while protecting our environment. This worldview—grounding opportunity in something more fundamental that we all share and must protect—permeates our organization, and forms the foundation of our approach to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).
  
  
CPI’s approach to DEI mirrors our mission: within a culture that values transparency and dialogue, we strive to improve equity within our organization as well as in the communities in which we work. Internally and externally, we seek to remove inequitable barriers regardless of their origin, whether it be class, race, religion, nationality, region, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation or physical ability. We are proactive in identifying and removing biases in our processes, seeking fairness in hiring, working conditions, and professional development.
  
  
If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.

title: GSPANN - SAP BTP Consultant

title: Global IT Data Architect Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Define architecture for key domains within the Data Products Portfolio.
* Evaluate data related tools and technologies and recommend appropriate implementation patterns and standard methodologies to ensure our Data ecosystem is always modern.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Data Architects in establishing and adhering to enterprise standards while also performing PoCs to ensure those standards are implemented.
* Provide technical expertise and mentorship to Data Engineers and Data Analysts in the Data & Solution Architecture.
* Develop and maintain processes, standards, policies, guidelines, and governance to ensure that a consistent framework and set of standards is applied across the company.
* Create and maintain conceptual / logical and Physica; data models to identify key business entities and visual relationships.
* Work with business and IT teams to understand data requirements.
* Maintain a data dictionary consisting of table and column definitions.
* Review Architecture with both technical and business audiences.
* Partner with Technology, Data Stewards and various Products teams in an Agile work stream while meeting program goals and deadlines.
* Champion architecture across the project lifecycle — working closely with Product Owners, Business, and BI&A teams as a trusted technical partner to shape and steer key decisions.
* Ability to put forward well-researched design approaches with clear pros and cons, evaluate and test new platform capabilities, and establish modern architectural ways of working across the team.
* Ability to craft & influcence well-structured proposals and present architectural recommendations persuasively, building stakeholder confidence and driving adoption of scalable, future-ready solutions.
* Lead to design / build new models to efficiently deliver the candidate and recuitment results to senior management.

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Essential Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Bachelor's degree in information science, data management, computer science or related field preferred.

**Essential Experience & Job Requirements**

* 12+ years of IT experience with major focus on data warehouse / database related projects.
* Expertise in cloud data platforms and databases like Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, data catalog, MDM etc.
* Expertise in writing SQL and database procedures.
* Proficient in designing solution architecture factoring in all integration points, data flows and security/vulnerabilities.
* Proficient in Data Modelling - conceptual, logical, and physical modelling.
* Proficient in documenting all the architecture related work performed.
* Hands on experience in data storage, ETL / ELT and data analytics tools and technologies e.g., Talend, dbt, Attunity, Golden Gate, Fivetran, APIs, Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx etc.
* Experienced in Data Warehousing design / development and BI / Analytical systems.
* Experience working projects using Agile methodologies.
* Strong hands-on experience with data and analytics data architecture, solution design, and engineering experience.
* Experience with Cloud Big Data technologies such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Experience with Python would be preferable.
* Experience working with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and Meta Scrum with cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Scrum Master, Architects, and data SMEs).
* Review existing databases, data architecture, data models across multiple systems and propose architecture enhancements for cross compatibility and target systems.
* Excellent written, oral communication and presentation skills to present architecture, features, and solution recommendations.

**GOOD TO HAVE: GENAI, AGENTIC AI & EMERGING ARCHITECTURE CAPABILITIES**
These GenAI capabilities are optional / preferred and are captured separately from the core Data Architect requirements above.
  
  

* Hands-on experience designing, evaluating, or supporting GenAI / LLM-enabled solutions, including proofs of concept and production-oriented architecture patterns.
* Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, multi-step orchestration, tool-using AI agents, and human-in-the-loop design considerations.
* Experience with retrieval architectures such as RAG, GraphRAG, hybrid search, semantic search, and context-grounding approaches for enterprise use cases.
* Familiarity with vector databases, knowledge graphs, metadata-rich knowledge stores, and enterprise knowledge base design for AI applications.
* Exposure to AI application frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain and LangGraph.
* Awareness of agent-to-agent interaction patterns, A2A concepts, model context management (MCP), and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP.
* Experience evaluating data readiness for GenAI use cases, including chunking strategy, retrieval quality, data lineage, access controls, and content governance.
* Understanding of prompt design, evaluation approaches, observability, guardrails, safety, and responsible AI controls in enterprise environments.
* Ability to partner with product, engineering, architecture, and governance teams to shape scalable GenAI-enabled data products and platforms.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Global functional portfolio technical leaders (Finance, HR, Marketing, Legal, Risk, IT), product owners, functional area teams across levels.
* Global Data portfolio Management & teams (Enterprise Data Model, Data Catalog, Master Data Management).
* Consulting and internal Data Tribe teams across BCG.

Additional info
  
  
**You're Good At**

* Design, document & train the team on the overall processes and process flows for the data products’ architecture.
* Resolve technical challenges in critical situations that require immediate resolution.
* Develop relationships with external stakeholders to maintain awareness of data and security issues and trends.
* Review work from other tech team members and provide feedback for growth.
* Implement Data Architecture and Data security policies that align with governance objectives and regulatory requirements.

*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*

title: CTO Technology & Data
description:
As the Director of Technology & Data, you will play a crucial role in overseeing the technology infrastructure and data management systems critical to our organization's success. Reporting directly to the Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for implementing and maintaining robust technology solutions and data management systems, ensuring the accuracy, privacy, and effective tracking of data in support of policy initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

The list, not limited to, as below provides more detailed descriptions of the role.

**Technology Leadership:**
Lead organization's technology initiatives, ensuring the adoption of cutting-edge tools and systems that enhance efficiency and effectiveness in delivering social development programs.

* Evaluate, select, implement technology solutions to enhance program effectiveness.
* Maintain and upgrade existing technology infrastructure.
* Oversee IT systems, hardware, and software, ensuring functionality and security.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technology-related issues promptly.

**Data Strategy:**
Develop and implement a comprehensive data strategy aligned with the organization's social development goals. This includes defining data governance standards, data collection and analysis methodologies, and data storage and security protocols.

* Design, develop, and maintain robust data management systems and databases.
* Oversee data collection, validation, and analysis processes.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance with relevant regulations.
* Implement data quality control measures to minimize errors and discrepancies.
* Establish and enforce data quality standards and practices to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of data across the organization.

**Data Analytics & Tracking:**

* Develop and execute data analytics and reporting strategies. Extract actionable insights from data to inform decision-making.
* Develop and implement systems for tracking and reporting on key data metrics.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on the status & performance of data management systems.

**Data Management Systems:**

* Implement & manage data management systems specifically designed for policy tracking, analysis.
* Work closely with the Policy Research & Advocacy team to understand data requirements for effective policy development.

**Data Privacy and Security:**
Oversee data privacy & security measures, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA). Implement robust data protection protocols and ensure staff adherence.

* Implement data security protocols to safeguard sensitive information.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and ethical guidelines.
* Develop disaster recovery and business continuity plans.

**Technology Innovations, Partnerships, Continuous Improvement:**

* Collaborate with external partners, vendors, and experts to leverage technology solutions and best practices to enhance the organization's impact.
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies. Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation to drive efficiency and effectiveness.

**Team Collaboration:**
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Policy Research & Advocacy & IT to ensure seamless integration of data systems with organizational processes.

**Qualifications:**

* Post-graduate degree in social sciences, management, Technology, computer science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 10-15 years of Proven experience in overseeing technology infrastructure and implementing data management systems in Social Development Sector.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data privacy regulations & data security best practices.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and platforms. Experience with qualitative & quantitative data collection & analysis using packages like DHIS, ONA, GBVIMS, SPSS, MS-Excel, MS-Word, MS-Access, Tableau, etc.
* Knowledge of data protection regulations (e.g. GDPR, HIPAA) & ethical data handling.
* Strong understanding of data privacy regulations and best practices.
* Excellent project management and a strategic mindset.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to develop and manage budgets effectively.

**Desired Qualities:**

* Entrepreneurial spirit and ‘get-it-done’ attitude.
* Operating style suited to working in a small organization setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued.
* Excellent leadership skills, including ability to manage multiple projects at a time.

**Compensation**

We offer a competitive salary package matching relevant experience, fitment & candidate’s existing compensation, at par with the Development Sector.

RWF is an equal opportunity employer with social inclusion as a key value. We do not discriminate based on gender, sexual orientation, caste, colour, creed, religious beliefs, appearance, and socio-economic background and encourage diversity at the workplace.

title: Head - Data M&E & Institutional Intelligence
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk operates on the principle that 'what gets measured, gets governed.' This role owns the data spine of the organisation — the independent control room that tells every layer of RightWalk whether systems are working, outcomes are real, and learning is being captured. Critically, this function must be independent of the program teams whose performance it measures. Data inflation and incentive-driven reporting are existential threats to RightWalk's credibility. The Head – Data, M&E & Institutional Intelligence is the institutional conscience of the organisation's evidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Data and indicator architecture**

* Design and own the end-to-end data architecture: from field input to impact indicators — definitions, collection protocols, validation logic, and storage.
* Build common data dictionaries across programs and states.
* Ensure indicator definitions are clear, auditable and usable by teams.
* Align program indicators with donor reporting, government dashboards and internal learning needs.

**2. Dashboards and institutional intelligence**

* Build and maintain real-time dashboards and standard report packs for the CEO, state teams, and donors.
* Drive institutional intelligence: cross-state comparisons, learning loops, and evidence synthesis for policy refinement.
* Convert data into actionable intelligence for policy, program and product decisions.
* Manage the Knowledge Management function — evidence library, document repositories, and institutional memory.

**3. M&E systems and quality assurance**

* Lead the M&E framework: indicator design, sampling methodology, periodic evaluation cycles, and external evaluation partnerships.
* Own data governance — data quality audits, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag dashboards, and anomaly detection.
* Lead and develop State M&E Leads (embedded in states, functionally reporting to this role).
* Conduct periodic verification, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag reviews and quality audits.
* Maintain strict independence from Program and State teams — this role's credibility depends on it.

**4. Learning loops and evidence building**

* Ensure field learning feeds into policy redesign, process improvement and product updates.
* Support impact evaluation readiness and external evaluation partnerships.
* Produce public-good outputs — impact reports, evidence briefs, and external publications that build RightWalk's credibility.

**5. Data governance and ethics**

* Define data access, privacy, anonymisation and data security protocols with Tech and People teams.
* Ensure responsible handling of beneficiary, field and government data.
* Create data discipline without making teams feel they are entering a tax raid.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* Organisation-wide M&E and data architecture drafted and adopted.
* A live dashboard exists that the CEO, State Directors, and donors can access — real-time, reliable, and action-oriented.
* Data quality audits are conducted every quarter; anomalies are surfaced, not suppressed.
* The organisation makes at least two key program design changes in direct response to M&E evidence.
* RightWalk publishes at least one credible external evidence brief that strengthens its policy positioning.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Setting programmatic targets — that is the program team's domain.
* Managing field delivery or GDN operations.
* Policy authorship or advocacy strategy.
* Tech platform development (though close collaboration with Tech is essential).
* Sit under state programs whose performance it must assess.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  10–16 years in M&E, data systems, evaluation, or research — ideally within development sector, government advisory, or research institutions.
* **Methods:**
  Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills — comfortable with both survey-based M&E and systems-level data architecture.
* **Tools:**
  Experience with MIS/dashboard design and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* **Independence:**
  Track record of building independent M&E functions that are trusted by leadership and donors alike.
* **Orientation:**
  Governance mindset - more interested in data integrity than in making numbers look good.
* **Sector:**
  Exposure to government data systems, HMIS, DISE, or similar public data infrastructure

title: Roster of International consultant – Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance and/or laboratory strengthening for AMR
description:
**Contractual Arrangement**
External consultant
  
  
**Job Posting**
Oct 16, 2026, 2:40:59 PM

Nov 14, 2026, 3:59:00 AM

India-New Delhi

Full-time
**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**
Please note that the deadline for receipt of applications indicated above reflects your personal device's system settings.
  
  
**Area of expertise**
Roster of International consultant – Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance and/or laboratory strengthening for AMR
  
  
**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia is establishing a roster of qualified consultants who may be engaged for specific assignments to strengthen national and regional AMR surveillance, clinical microbiology services and laboratory systems. Assignments may cover surveillance design and assessment; implementation and reporting through the Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS); bacteriology and mycology capacity; diagnostic stewardship; laboratory networks and quality systems; data quality, analysis, interpretation and visualization; One Health and genomic surveillance; capacity development; operational research; and translation of surveillance evidence into policy and programme action.
  
  
Depending on the individual Terms of Reference, consultants will provide technical assistance for planning, implementation, analysis and reporting using WHO tools, standards and recommendations. They may also contribute to evidence-based technical guidance, protocols, standard operating procedures, training packages and implementation tools.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance is a major public health and development challenge in the WHO South-East Asia Region. Member States need timely, representative and quality-assured data on resistance patterns and antimicrobial use to guide national action plans, clinical and public health interventions, laboratory strategies, stewardship, infection prevention and control, and resource allocation.
  
  
Reliable laboratory systems are essential for effective AMR surveillance, including accurate bacterial and fungal identification, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, diagnostic stewardship, specimen referral, quality management and standardized data flows. WHO supports Member States, country offices and partners to strengthen sustainable surveillance and laboratory systems aligned with WHO standards and GLASS. This roster will help WHO SEARO identify specialists for time-bound regional or country assignments based on emerging needs.
  
  
**Deliverables**
Under The Overall Guidance Of WHO Technical Unit, Consultants May Be Requested To Perform One Or More Of The Following Assignments (a More Specific Terms Of Reference (TORs), Including The Exact Deliverables, Duration Of Assignment And Place Of Assignment Will Be Shared With The Selected Candidate At The Time Of Hiring For a Specific Assignment):
  
  
****Deliverable 1: Surveillance and laboratory assessment.****
Conduct desk or country assessment of AMR surveillance systems, data flows, governance arrangements, indicators, data quality, bacteriology and mycology capacity, laboratory networks, diagnostic stewardship and reporting processes, with prioritized and feasible recommendations
  
  
****Deliverable 2: Technical products and implementation tools.****
Design assignment-specific protocols, standard operating procedures, data dictionaries, validation checklists, surveillance tools, indicator frameworks, laboratory-strengthening plans, survey materials, diagnostic-stewardship tools, guidance documents or One Health implementation products
  
  
****Deliverable 3: Data and analytical outputs.****
Develop cleaned or validated datasets; statistical, microbiological or genomic analyses; reproducible code or pipelines; tables, figures, maps, dashboards or visualization specifications; interpretation notes; and quality documentation, as applicable
  
  
****Deliverable 4: Laboratory and diagnostic products.****
Adapt guidance documents, training packages and tools for clinical bacteriology and mycology; laboratory quality management; antimicrobial susceptibility testing; external quality assurance; specimen referral; laboratory networks; and diagnostic stewardship.
  
  
****Deliverable 5: Capacity-development package.****
Develop training needs findings, curricula, presentations, exercises, job aids, workshop or webinar facilitation, mentoring records and a brief evaluation of learning and follow-up needs.
  
  
****Deliverable 6: Reporting and knowledge products.****
Prepare GLASS submission-related outputs, national or regional surveillance reports, laboratory-capacity reports, policy briefs, technical reports, manuscripts, systematic reviews, presentations or other communication products.
  
  
****Educational Qualifications****
**Qualifications, experience, skills and languages**
**Essential:**
**Band level B:**
A first university degree or medical degree in epidemiology, public health, medicine, clinical microbiology, laboratory sciences, biostatistics, statistics, mathematical modelling, health informatics, data science, computer science, bioinformatics, veterinary public health, environmental health, pharmacy, health economics or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
**Band level C:**
An advanced university degree or medical degree with postgraduate specialization in one of the fields listed above or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
Desirable: Additional postgraduate training, specialization or professional certification relevant to the technical profile, such as clinical microbiology, bacteriology, mycology, field epidemiology, laboratory quality management, diagnostic stewardship, data analytics, geographic information systems, genomic epidemiology, health information systems, monitoring and evaluation, or adult learning.
  
  
****Experience****
Essential
  
  
Band level B: At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the technical profiles advertised.
  
  
**Band Level C:**

* At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the advertised technical profiles.
* Demonstrated experience producing high-quality, assignment-relevant outputs such as surveillance assessments, protocols, analytical products, laboratory tools, technical reports, training packages, dashboards, scientific publications or policy products.
* For laboratory-focused assignments, essential experience may include one or more of the following:
* Implementation of recognized antimicrobial susceptibility testing standards, such as CLSI or EUCAST.
* Microbiological proficiency testing or external quality-assurance programmes.
* Bacteriology or mycology laboratory assessments and laboratory-system strengthening.
* Mycological diagnosis, diagnostic stewardship or laboratory quality management.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with AMR surveillance and GLASS-related methods, tools or reporting.
* Experience working with ministries of health, national AMR programmes, public health institutes, reference laboratories, academic institutions or One Health coordination mechanisms.
* Experience in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in the WHO South-East Asia Region.
* Experience with WHO, another United Nations entity or an international public health organization.
* Experience facilitating multidisciplinary or multisectoral work and transferring skills to national teams.
* Experience implementing infectious-disease surveys or clinical research studies in accordance with good clinical and data-management practices.
* A publication record in peer-reviewed journals or authorship of technical guidance, national reports, research proposals, systematic reviews or evidence-synthesis products.
* Experience developing and applying bioinformatics pipelines, where relevant to the assignment.

**Essential**
**Skills and knowledge**

* Advanced knowledge and competence in at least one advertised technical profile, with a sound understanding of public health surveillance or laboratory-system principles relevant to the assignment.
* Ability to apply relevant WHO standards, methods and tools to national or regional contexts.
* Ability to analyse complex information, assure data or laboratory quality, interpret findings and formulate practical recommendations.
* Excellent technical writing, presentation and communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and policy audiences.
* Ability to work effectively in multicultural and multidisciplinary settings and to deliver quality outputs within agreed timelines.
* For laboratory-focused assignments, essential competencies may include quality-assured microbiological testing, assessment of bacteriology or mycology laboratories, and design or implementation of external quality-assurance programmes.

Desirable
  
  

* Knowledge of GLASS, national AMR surveillance systems, One Health surveillance and relevant laboratory standards.
* Knowledge of laboratory networks and specimen-referral systems in resource-limited settings and associated challenges.
* Proficiency in one or more relevant platforms or languages, such as R, R Markdown, R Shiny, Python, SQL, Power BI, DHIS2, geographic information systems, statistical software, laboratory information systems, web technologies or bioinformatics tools.
* Knowledge of data governance, privacy, security, interoperability and reproducible analytical practices.
* Knowledge of adult learning, training design, facilitation and mentoring approaches.

****Languages And Level Required****
Essential: Expert knowledge of English.
  
  
Desirable: Intermediate or expert knowledge of another official United Nations language or a language used in a WHO South-East Asia Region Member State, where relevant to the assignment.
  
  
**Location**
Consultancies may be: Home-based, Country-based, Regional Office-based, or a combination of remote and in-country support. The duty arrangement for each consultancy will be specified in the individual Terms of Reference.
  
  
**Travel**
The consultant may be expected to travel to one or more WHO South-East Asia Region Member States for country assessments, laboratory assessments, technical consultations, training or other assignment-related activities. Travel dates, locations and purpose will be specified in the individual Terms of Reference and arranged in accordance with applicable WHO policies.
  
  
**Remuneration and budget (travel costs are excluded)**
**Remuneration:**
Band level B and/or Band level C, as applicable to the assignment. The daily or monthly rate will be established in accordance with the applicable WHO consultant remuneration guidance and stated in the individual Terms of Reference.
  
  
**Living expenses:**
Not applicable for home-based work. When an assignment requires on-site presence or travel, applicable travel and subsistence arrangements will be specified separately in accordance with WHO policies.
  
  
**Expected duration of contract**
: Roster assignments may range from short inputs to several months, up to a maximum of 11 months per calendar year. Each individual Terms of Reference will specify the contract duration, number of working days and, for part-time assignments, the expected percentage or level of effort.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud, and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to help our customers be successful with MongoDB.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The position will be based in our Gurugram office. The standard work week will be Sunday to Thursday, every week.
  
  
Cool things you’ll do
  
  
You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
  
  
What you need
  
  
You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.
  
  
The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas
  
  

* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi-cluster deployments
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi-pathing, and caching
* Experience building and maintaining complex mission-critical production database systems
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
  
  
You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.
  
  
*You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
Bonus Points
  
  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Experience with virtualization, Docker, Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

What you’ll be DOING
  
  
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  
End-to-end BAU (Run) responsibility for the GRM risk tooling ecosystem leveraging Microsoft Azure / Databricks, including:
  
  

* Natural Event Platform application landscape (run + operational support)

You will report to be defined – GRM Tech Owner / Run Manager).

We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**- BAU / Run operations ownership (core mission)

- Project support (punctual contribution)

* Stakeholder management & governance rhythm
* Act as the operational focal point for GRM and platform stakeholders, participating in governance/rituals (initiative reviews, risk follow-ups) as required.

**Specialist Skills & Experience (must-have)**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* good hands-on expertise with Databricks in production contexts (workflows/jobs scheduling, cluster policies, libraries, notebooks, troubleshooting).
* Advanced PySpark and SQL skills for investigation and remediation of data and pipeline issues.
* Experience with production support for data platforms/app ecosystems (L2/L3).

Run/Service Management
  
  

* Proven experience operating services under SLA/OLA constraints: incident/problem/change management, runbooks, operational reporting.

Cost / Performance / Reliability
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to manage compute cost, performance tuning, and reliability improvements—particularly relevant for scalable run workloads

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Experience in cloud data platforms and enterprise data governance constraints (access management, secure data handling).
* Familiarity with integration patterns (API management, managed file transfer approaches) in data exchange ecosystems.
* Exposure to risk modeling / catastrophe modeling application contexts (helpful but not required).

Key interfaces (who the role works with)
  
  

* GRM Tech & Product stakeholders (application owners, BAU owners, governance leads) across Natural Event Platform, STEC apps
* AXA GO, mainly GDP & CFGP teams (engineering) but as well transversal GO families such as security, access management, architecture supporting the platform releases and readiness.
* Project teams during transformations

Success measures (KPIs / outcomes)
  
  

* High service stability: reduced incident volume, improved MTTR, fewer recurring problems.
* Operational readiness: complete runbooks, monitoring coverage, predictable release transitions.
* Cost and performance control: measurable improvements in compute cost monitoring and optimization (especially on Notus run consumption).
* Stakeholder satisfaction (derived from the three criteria above): clear communication, reliable support, proactive risk management.

Working model (ESS – India)
  
  

* Coverage aligned to GRM needs.
* On call / extended support windows if required during major releases or critical incidents.

Who WE are
  
  
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.

AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. title: Manager - Data Steward
description:
Join our team and you will have an opportunity to work in a collaborative and dynamic environment. This newly created role will join a team of data professionals focused on advancing data management capabilities and strengthening data as a strategic asset.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, as a Data Steward, you will play a critical part in ensuring the integrity, quality, and governance of data across the organization for data delivered through Macquarie’s central data warehouse and Data Hub. You will work across business and technology teams to develop a clear understanding of critical data, its business meaning, ownership, source, transformation, lineage, quality, and usage. You will partner with data owners, subject matter experts, data producers, architects, and consumers to maintain trusted data, identify governance gaps, and coordinate practical remediation. * Experience identifying data quality, lineage, ownership, metadata, and control gaps and coordinating remediation activities.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation is preferred
* Experience with data governance and metadata tools such as Collibra, along with Jira and Confluence along with familiarity with Power BI, data warehouse concepts, data models, and enterprise data platforms is desirable.
* Strong Stakeholder management skills along with ability to prepare governance reporting and communicate risks and remediation progress
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare governance reporting and communicate risks and remediation progress.

description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy-1
  
  
Sr. Analyst, Master Data Management
  
  
Location: Gurgaon, India
  
  
Reports to: Vice President, Master Data Management
  
  
**About The Position**
The Sr. Analyst of Master Data Management (MDM) is responsible for execution of Mastercard’s MDM strategy across the enterprise. This role is instrumental in shaping and implementing the strategic vision for MDM initiatives, ensuring alignment with broader enterprise data governance goals.
  
  
In close partnership with business and technology stakeholders, the Sr. Analyst will operationalize MDM and governance practices to uphold the consistency, accuracy, and integrity of mastered data assets. This role demands strong cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders across Franchise, Product, Corporate, Mastercard Technology, and global business units to drive and sustain the data management strategy.
  
  
As a subject matter expert in master and reference data management, this individual will represent the Office of the Chief Data Officer (CDO) in executing MDM best practices to promote enterprise-wide data excellence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design & Implementation: Design and implement Master Data Management (MDM) solutions aligned with strategic business objectives and guided by leadership direction. Key responsibilities include gathering requirements, architecting solutions, configuring platforms such as Reltio, and maintaining ongoing operations. This role also oversees system upgrades, migrations, and new deployments, ensuring timely execution of MDM initiatives while fostering continuous improvement in data management practices.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between IT, business stakeholders, and data governance teams to ensure seamless integration and adoption of MDM solutions across enterprise systems (e.g., Merchant data platform, Oracle Financials, Coupa, Salesforce, Mastercard Billing System).
* Data Quality & Governance: Partner with the data quality team to streamline data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, and lifecycle management. Monitor and report on data quality KPIs. Partner with governance teams to establish and enforce standards, frameworks, and best practices across master data domains (e.g., merchant, customer, consumer, product, supplier, legal entity).
* Automation & Integration: Drive automation of data ingestion and mastered data consumption processes. Ensure integration of MDM solutions with enterprise applications, Mastercard product and related data pipelines.
* Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure adherence to data privacy, quality, and regulatory requirements while building global solutions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: Demonstrated experience in Master Data Management (MDM) roles within large enterprise environments, with a minimum of 3 years of relevant MDM experience and at least 1 full-cycle MDM implementations. Proven hands-on expertise in large-scale MDM platforms such as Reltio or Informatica, along with familiarity with data warehousing, analytics and ERP systems.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Experienced data professional with strong problem-solving skills and expertise in enterprise data products and architecture. Proficient in Hadoop, Databricks, RDBMS, SQL, Alteryx, and Excel. Skilled in data integration, metadata management, and taxonomy modeling. Adept at designing scalable data platforms, including data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, and real-time pipelines. Proven ability to lead data strategy and unify fragmented ecosystems in complex organizations.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with master data domains relevant to the financial services and technology industries—such as merchant, customer, consumer, product, and financial master data—is preferred.
* Leadership: Implement MDM and governance frameworks, collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive change.
* Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated success in stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration.
* Mindset: Self-starter with a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Ability to deliver results under tight deadlines.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction To Team**
Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.
  
  
The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.
  
  
We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.
  
  
As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

description:

The role will drive digital transformation initiatives, establish enterprise-wide reporting standards, manage PMIS platforms, and lead multidisciplinary teams delivering reporting, analytics, automation, and project controls solutions for business stakeholders and clients.

*PIMS, Platforms & Systems Delivery*

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
Looking for a skilled and proactive
**Linux/Window Engineer**
to manage, support, and enhance enterprise Linux/Windows infrastructure. The role will involve a combination of
**Business-as-Usual (BAU) operational support and infrastructure project delivery**
, ensuring high availability, performance, security, and stability of Windows/Linux-based systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Linux/Windows administration, troubleshooting, automation and infrastructure operations, along with experience supporting technology transformation, migration, and modernization initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Responsibilities:**

* Works closely with Operations and Engineering Teams to identify feature sets that impact private and public cloud platforms to ensure availability and reduce toil
* Performs hands-on architecture, design and development of monitoring systems to provide continuous support for ongoing infrastructure and application availability
* Understands current incidents and provides solutions to detect, recover, and prevent re-occurrence
* Strong hands-on experience in OS(Linux/Windows) administration, to manage day-to-day Linux/Windows BAU operations and production support.

* Support infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and modernization projects.
* Execute planned changes, maintenance activities, and production deployments.

* Collaborate with application, database, network, storage, and security teams.
* Follow ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management.
* Maintain SOPs, technical documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Support project implementation, testing, cutover, and post-deployment activities.
* Demonstrate strong troubleshooting, ownership, stakeholder management, and ability to balance BAU and project deliverables.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in Linux infrastructure administration and enterprise production support.
* Proven experience balancing BAU operational responsibilities with infrastructure engineering and project implementation activities.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Senior Platform Engineer in Global Technology and Operations, you will report to the Lead, Tech Lead (Full Stack) and partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, business users, engineers and delivery professionals to improve Financial Accounting and Procurement Platforms. You will code, test and debug new and existing applications as you implement capabilities to solve sophisticated business problems, and you will deploy innovative products, services and experiences to delight our customers!
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Build applications ensuring that the code follows latest coding practices and industry standards, using modern design patterns and architectural principles; with guidance, actively code and execute against the roadmap
* Develop high-quality, well-documented and efficient code adhering to all applicable Prudential standards
* Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
* Write unit, integration tests and functional automation, researching problems discovered by quality assurance or product support
* Continue to advance understanding of relevant and emerging technologies with learning and innovation embedded in the day-to-day
* Work on problems of moderate scope in which analysis of situation or data requires a review of identifiable factors
* Use programming languages including but not limited to Python, Java, and JavaScript
* Design and configure new API integrations between Procurement SaaS Applications; troubleshoot existing integrations between Procurement SaaS Applications

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering or experience in related fields
* 5–7 years of experience with Oracle EBS Procure to Pay modules
* Financial knowledge/experience (investments, actuarial, finance)
* Exposure to agentic AI concepts and frameworks, with the ability to design, guide, and implement AI-driven solutions that leverage autonomous agents to enhance business and technology outcomes
* Leverage diverse ideas, experiences, thoughts and perspectives to the benefit of the organization
* Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
* Knowledge of Procure-to-Pay Processes
* Knowledge of underlying Oracle EBS Procurement and Payables database tables and associated SQL queries
* Experience working directly with Business Users to gather requirements
* Mandatory experience designing new Procure to Pay processes (preferrable in Oracle Source to Pay)
* Ability to learn new SaaS applications, new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling on challenges
* Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Experience with the following:
* Programming Languages: Oracle PL/SQL, SQL, Python, Java or Java Script Is preferred
* Data Store: NoSQL or Relational Data structures
* Knowledge/understanding of the following:
* Application Programming Interfaces (API): Consumption & Development; implementing service-oriented architecture (SOA) patterns; Web service technologies such as APIs, REST, JSON, Postman
* Unit, interface and end user testing concepts and tooling (functional & non-functional)
* Automated testing
* Accessibility awareness
* Software security skills including secure coding, web application security and DevSecOps; Solid grasp of security concepts (authentication, authorization, encryption, digital signature, JWT), SSL, web service proxies, firewall, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0)
* Dev Ops Tools & Practices: Branching techniques and usage of GitHub, Bitbucket or Subversion; DevOps, Jenkins

**What will set you apart?**

* Architecture Patterns
* Design Thinking
* SaaS Applications API design and configuration
* Oracle EBS Procure-to-Pay modules experience
* PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: Cloud Administrator
description:
This role is technical in nature and focuses on building and maintaining Microsoft SQL Server and Postgres databases. You will be responsible for the delivery of database support services to FNZ platforms hosted in public cloud environments (Azure and AWS), through Infrastructure as Code pipelines and manual builds.

The Cloud Infrastructure team is small, and each team member is given the opportunity to own significant parts of the solution end to end. The Cloud DBA is expected to work with the Cloud Engineers to develop the best possible database solution for our internal stakeholders to do our part in delivering customer success.

**Team Responsibilities: -**

1. Automate the design, build, and maintenance of database environments to ensure high availability and scalability.
2. Use monitoring tools to optimize performance and proactively resolve issues.
3. Implement automated backup and disaster recovery pipelines to protect critical data.
4. Enforce security through automated user and access management.
5. Diagnose and resolve performance issues using modern diagnostic tools.
6. Leverage cloud-native automation to scale storage and manage capacity efficiently.

**Specific Role Responsibilities:-**

* Maintain and monitor Azure and AWS database services to ensure high availability and performance.
* Troubleshoot issues, optimize queries, and meet performance SLAs.
* Implement and manage backups, failover solutions, and disaster recovery plans.
* Enforce security protocols and manage access controls.
* Collaborate with the cloud engineering team to design, build, and run pipelines that automate database build and maintenance tasks.
* Support database builds and project delivery while working closely with developers to optimize performance.
* Participate in a global on-call support roster to address critical issues and maintain service reliability.
* Stay updated on Azure and AWS technologies and share knowledge with the team.
* Manage incident, problem and change management via FNZs ticketing solution.
* Participate in risk management and information security initiatives, supporting internal and external audits.
* Manage escalations to the appropriate stakeholders.

**Performance Assessment**

* Uptime and performance metrics in Azure and AWS
* Quality of security documentation and adherence to cloud security standards.
* Backup and recovery test results, and DR plan performance in cloud environments.
* Project timelines, quality metrics, and cost efficiency.

**Experience Required**

* Required2+ years of experience as a Database Administrator in Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, including database design and optimization.
* Demonstrated ability or strong interest in working within dynamic, high-availability environments. Exposure to or eagerness to learn about mission-critical systems is highly valued.
* Proven ability to work as an individual, with excellent self-management and time management skills.
* Ability to participate in an on-call roster and perform some work outside normal business hours.
* Superior problem-solving capabilities and the ability to multitask and re-prioritise work in a rapidly changing environment.

**Desirable**

* Experience with other cloud data storage services such as Microsoft Fabric or Power BI .
* Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and capacity planning.

****Why join us at Nural****

Nural is a 2020-founded B2B SaaS company building the Nural One suite (Sales, Service, Assets and Analytics) used by field and operations teams at recognised brands including Motorola, Sony, Kohler, LAVA, Nothing and Fiserv.

As an Infra Support Engineer, you won’t be a small cog watching tickets pile up — you’ll own the infrastructure that keeps these products live, fast and reliable for real enterprise customers, every single day.

We’re a small, flat, fast-moving team, so the systems you strengthen and the calls you make on uptime, deployments and security are visible and valued from day one — with plenty of room to pick up cloud, DevOps and automation skills as we scale.

******Job Overview******

We’re looking for an Infra Support Engineer to manage and support the Windows-based application infrastructure, IIS servers, databases, deployments, monitoring and CI/CD activities that keep Nural’s products running. You’ll work closely with our development and application teams to maintain uptime, troubleshoot infrastructure issues fast, and keep deployments smooth and safe — a role with real ownership and a direct line of sight to the customers who depend on what you support.

****Key Responsibilities:****

**Infrastructure & Application Support**

* Manage and monitor Windows Servers and IIS application environments.
* Perform application deployments and support QA, staging, and production environments.
* Manage server/application configuration and environment-related changes.
* Perform server health checks and assist with infrastructure maintenance.

**Monitoring & Troubleshooting**

* Monitor server CPU, memory, disk space, services, and application logs.
* Troubleshoot issues using Windows Event Viewer, IIS logs, application logs, and server monitoring tools.
* Investigate incidents and coordinate with development, database, network, and other technical teams for resolution.

**CI/CD & Deployments**

* Manage and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Work with developers to troubleshoot application and server-related issues.
* Maintain backup and deployment procedures and ensure safe deployment practices.

**Database Support**

* Perform basic SQL Server database troubleshooting and connectivity checks.
* Monitor and troubleshoot SQL Server Agent jobs and scheduled jobs.
* Support database connectivity issues using SSMS.

**Network, DNS & Security**

* Manage and troubleshoot DNS and SSL/certificate-related issues.
* Work with Cloudflare and GoDaddy DNS configurations.
* Follow security, backup, access-control, and change-management procedures.

**Documentation**

* Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

**Preferred Skills**

* Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions
* Docker
* AWS / Azure
* Terraform
* Kubernetes
* PowerShell scripting
* Monitoring and logging tools

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume to hr@nuraltech.com with the subject line “Infra Support Engineer”, or apply directly via nuraltech.com/careers.
